jobs.title: Program Coordinator (5156C), Summer Sessions, Study Abroad, Lifelong Learning & University Extension
jobs.description:
Program Coordinator (5156C), Summer Sessions, Study Abroad, Lifelong Learning & University Extension About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
Summer Sessions, Study Abroad, Lifelong Learning & University Extension (SSALLEX) is the extended education division of the University of California, Berkeley and an essential part of the University's mission to extend the research and scholarship of UC Berkeley to a global community.
  
  
SSALLEX is a vibrant and dynamic organization that enables more than 60,000 visiting UC and potential Cal students; parents, faculty, academic units, international business partners, and central campus service providers engage in campus activities. The department provides more than 2,000 summer courses, early-start programs, study abroad experiences, global internships, and year-around programs or courses, lectures, special events and interest circles for older adults.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Based on the continued growth and expansion of the First-Year Edge & Transfer Edge program, the Program Coordinator is needed to support the execution and management of the program's operations. This position would work with the Director and would be responsible for applying advanced student services expertise and coordinating the academic advising, logistical, programmatic, and administrative operations of the First-Year Edge & Transfer Edge summer program for newly admitted UC Berkeley students.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is November 23, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Apply full range of student support services to newly admitted students pursuing the First-Year Edge & Transfer Edge program.
  
Provide on-going advising to prospective and matriculated students, families, and legal guardians and effectively manage a high volume of inquiries from prospective and matriculated students as well as campus and internal partners
  
Advise Director on university and program specific policies and procedures as well as program development, administration and general logistics.
  
Advise students on topics such as but not limited to eligibility requirements, opt-in/opt-out process, financial aid, academics, housing, support services, and resources for the course enrollment process.
  
Resolve student services-related issues and grievances during and after the course of the program, including course enrollment, billing, withdrawal/cancellation, appeals process, and other related inquiries.
  
Plan, implement and participate in virtual, local, domestic, and other outreach events and recruitment opportunities primarily in California as well as hosting and facilitating in-person and online outreach events, such as information sessions and pre-program webinars
  
Responsible for interpreting organization policies and advising students and faculty on student conduct, student grievances, disputes, and issues regarding discrimination.
  
Oversees and may conduct orientations of new students.
  
Plan and implement student programming, events and orientations aimed at equipping newly admitted first-year and transfer students with the knowledge to succeed during the course of the program and in their transition to UC Berkeley
  
Develops and enhances an alumni recruitment network. Including coordinating the recruitment, hiring, and training process of student staff including program assistants and program ambassadors
  
Support emergency and crisis management intervention
  
Maintain confidential conduct records as defined by FERPA, Clery, Title IX, and other regulations
  
Create, update, and maintain student databases and provide data insights and analysis when needed.
  
Develop and maintain program literature and resources, including program website and knowledge base, and maintain external and on-going communication to various constituents
  
Coordinating administrative and operational tasks including but not limited to making purchases, invoice and vendor payments, expense pre-approvals, and reimbursements
  
Evaluate short-term and long-term success of programs and make recommendations to changes in policy, practice, and procedure accordingly.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Working knowledge of advising and counseling techniques.
  
Skills in judgment and decision making, problem identification, problem-solving, reasoning.
  
Interpersonal skills and multicultural competencies; ability to work with diverse populations, including high school students, freshmen and transfer students.
  
Effective verbal, written and cross-cultural communication skills.
  
Strong customer service orientation.
  
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks.

jobs.title: MPS Program Coordinator (4973C) - MPS Dean's Office
jobs.description:
MPS Program Coordinator (4973C) - MPS Dean's Office About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and providing space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Pla n, which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride.
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The MPS Dean's Diversity Office initiates, implements, and evaluates efforts and conducts research on student, postdoc, and faculty success in the mathematical and physical science fields with an emphasis on ensuring fair access and equitable outcomes. The Assistant Dean and their staff organize new initiatives, develop new funding, and support departmental efforts to students, and receive all work duties directly from the Assistant Dean. Collaborates with professors, graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, faculty, staff, and administrators from UCB and national partners.
  
  
Currently projects underway include MPS Scholars and the MPS Scholarship Program at the undergraduate level, a doctoral advancement program, and a postdoc study. This position is responsible for providing programmatic, administrative, and financial coordination for MPS Dean's Office. Provides support to the Assistant Dean. The Assistant Dean advises the Deans and Department Chairs, manages and provides assistance to several student organizations, conducts research, develops new programs, and works to enhance equity among the faculty, staff, and students in the MPS departments.
  
  
The position requires in-depth understanding of campus policies and administrative practices. The position holder is a key point of contact for all MPS Dean's Office business and must be able to work with a high degree of independence with good judgement and follow through.
  
  
MPS Scholars is the official student success and mentorship program of the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, offered collaboratively with the Departments of Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Open to all intended and declared MPS majors, MPS Scholars provides opportunities to build community, explore academic and career pathways, and thrive throughout the Berkeley experience.
  
  
Since launching in Fall 2022, thousands of students have participated in MPS Scholars through mentorship, events, workshops, and academic and career resources.
  
  
MPS Scholars is a structured program, supported by funding from the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation. It provides activities and opportunities such as: A supportive mentoring network of advanced students, faculty, professional scientists, and alumni. Welcome and orientation programs for incoming students. Research and internship opportunities in academic and industry settings. Career development workshops, courses, networking events, and graduate school preparation. Academic resources designed to support success in MPS majors. Retreats, social events, and community-building activities that connect students with peers, graduate mentors, staff, alumni, and faculty across the MPS departments.
  
  
The Mathematical and Physical Sciences Scholarship Program (MPSSP) awards up to $15,000 per year in scholarship support to eligible students in Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Funded by the National Science Foundation's S-STEM program, MPSSP scholars receive financial support while participating fully in the MPS Scholars community.
  
  
At the graduate level, a bridge grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation grant is focused on establishing a prototype for the establishment of a Sloan Center for Systemic Change (SCSC) at Berkeley by establishing a consortium of departments working together to advance their equity goals.
  
  
At the postdoctoral level, the Postdoc Study, supported by a grant from the Heising-Simons Foundation, is designed to provide a clearer understanding of the experiences of postdoctoral scholars and causes of patterns of career selection among postdocs in the MPS fields at top-tier universities and national research facilities.
  
  
The MPS Program Coordinator coordinates and administers academic support and student success programs within the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, including MPS Scholars and the NSF S-STEM Scholarship Program. The position supports the development and implementation of programs designed to enhance the academic, professional, and personal success of undergraduate and graduate students, with particular attention to students who may face barriers to academic success.
  
  
Working under the direction of the Assistant Dean and in collaboration with faculty, staff, students, and campus and external partners, the Program Coordinator provides programmatic support, coordinates mentoring and professional development activities, supports students in navigating academic and other challenges, and assists with program assessment and evaluation. The position also coordinates program communications and outreach, supervises student and peer staff,

The Professional Development (PD) Program Coordinator administers and coordinates the day-to-day operation of El Camino

Health’s professional development and clinical education programs, such as the HealthStream learning management system

(LMS), Relationship-Based Care (RBC), Crisis Prevention Instruction (CPI), the ECH Clinical Ladder program, and more.

Reporting to the Director of Clinical Education, this role serves as the central point of coordination and governance for these

programs by ensuring learning assignments, competencies, records, and program logistics are accurate, timely, compliant,

and consistently delivered across clinical staff.

Working with a high degree of independence, the PD Program Coordinator handles a wide range of program administration

improve workflows and prevent avoidable rework. The role safeguards the integrity of regulatory-required training and

competency records, supports organizational readiness for Joint Commission surveys and Magnet Program requirements, and

serves as a resource to those who rely on these programs.

In addition to program coordination, the role provides direct administrative support to the operational leaders of these

Business Operations by coordinating meetings, materials, reporting, and follow-up that keep initiatives organized and on

track.

logistics so each program is delivered consistently and on schedule.

* Establishes and maintains centralized governance and quality controls over learning assignments to prevent duplicate,

outdated, or missed module assignments and to reduce avoidable retraining and rework.

* Monitors mandatory education and competency due dates; proactively identify at-risk assignments and coordinates with

Nursing Professional Development Specialists (NPDS) and Clinical Managers to maintain survey readiness.

* Generates, maintains, and distributes completion, compliance, and competency reports; responds accurately and

promptly to requests from leadership, regulatory bodies, and accrediting agencies (e.g., Joint Commission, CDPH, CMS,

Magnet).

* Applies discretion to modify and improve program workflows, standard operating procedures, and coordination

standards that increase efficiency and enhance the participant and stakeholder experience.

* Resolves atypical or non-routine program, scheduling, LMS, and data issues using established precedents and practices;

escalates broader risks as appropriate.

* Maintains program documentation, job aids, and reference materials; guides and supports NPDS, managers, and staff in

navigating HealthStream and program requirements.

* Coordinates with vendors and system partners (e.g., HealthStream) on configuration, updates, and issue resolution.
* Provides direct administrative support to the operational leaders of professional development programs—including the

Director of Clinical Education, the Director of the Magnet Program, and the Director of Clinical Business Operations.

* Prepares and formats agendas, meeting notes, presentations, and executive summaries for program leaders; tracks

action items and deadlines to keep initiatives moving.

* Serves as a formal or informal resource to less-experienced colleagues and provides cross-coverage for key program

administration functions during peak needs or absences.

**Qualifications**

* Associate’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Education, Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or an

equivalent combination of education and experience; Bachelor’s degree preferred.

* Typically 2–4+ years of experience in program administration, learning management system administration, clinical

education support, training coordination, or a related operational role.

build, assignments, user management, reporting, and record maintenance.

* Demonstrated ability to handle a wide range of program administration tasks independently and to resolve atypical, non-

* Experience providing administrative support to leaders or executives preferred.

jobs.description:
We are so glad you are interested in joining Sutter Health!

**Organization:**

SPMF-Sutter Pacific Medical Foundation - South

**Position Overview:**

Serves as the first point of contact for patients calling to schedule appointments and access care. This role is responsible for scheduling appointments, answering general questions, and guiding patients through the next steps in their care journey. Responsibilities include updating patient registration information, verifying insurance coverage, reviewing payor rosters to determine network participation, and assisting patients with insurance-related inquiries.  
This position acts as a vital bridge between patients and care teams by relaying accurate, clear, and concise information to ensure timely resolution of patient needs. The incumbent is responsible for documenting patient concerns appropriately and communicating messages in a manner that enables clinical and operational teams to effectively assist the patient.  
Maintains adherence to departmental Standard Work and organizational workflows while meeting individual performance metrics, including average handle time, after-call work, quality standards, and scripting compliance. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, active listening, critical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to demonstrate empathy and compassion when supporting patients, particularly during times of stress, uncertainty, or frustration.  
Essential Responsibilities  
Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments accurately and efficiently.  
Answer patient inquiries and provide guidance regarding next steps in care.  
Update patient demographics, registration information, and insurance coverage.  
Verify network participation and reference payor rosters as needed.  
Communicate patient concerns and requests to care teams through clear, complete, and concise documentation.  
Follow departmental Standard Work, workflows, and organizational policies.  
Meet established productivity and quality metrics, including average handle time, after-call work, service level expectations, and quality monitoring standards.  
Demonstrate professionalism, active listening, empathy, and customer service excellence in all patient interactions.  
Utilize critical thinking and problem-solving skills to resolve patient concerns and remove barriers to care.  
Compliance and Additional Duties  
Adheres to all organizational, local, state, and federal regulations, policies, procedures, and confidentiality requirements to ensure patient privacy, safety, and the delivery of high-quality care. **EDUCATION:**  
*Equivalent experience will be accepted in lieu of the required degree or diploma.*  
HS Diploma or equivalent education/experience

1 year of recent relevant experience.

Basic knowledge of insurance policies and procedures, as well as patient billing.  
  
Ability to interpret a variety of data and instructions, furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.  
  
Possess written and verbal communications skills to communicate with fellow team members, supervisors, patients, and other hospital personnel.  
  
Well-developed time management and organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize assignments and work within standardized policies and procedures to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.  
  
General knowledge of computer applications, such as Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel and Outlook).  
  
Prioritize assignments and work within standardized policies and procedures to achieve objectives and meet deadlines.  
  
Work independently, as well as be part of the team, including accomplishing multiple tasks in an environment with interruptions.

Job Category

Employee Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters**  
  
The Program Manager, M&A Recruiting provides critical operational, administrative, and tactical support across the complete transaction lifecycle—from diligence through post-close integration. Working in close partnership with the Program Manager, this individual manages day-to-day recruiting operational tasks, candidate data migration logistics, reporting, and maintenance of the M&A Recruiting Toolkit. This IC role ensures consistent execution, accuracy of deal documentation, and smooth pre-boarding workflows for acquired talent.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities & Scope**

* Support pre-boarding and onboarding workflows in Workday, including interim new hire offer letter logistics, background verification tracking, and interim capacity/headcount requests.
* Maintain up-to-date documentation, process maps, training materials, intake forms, RACI templates, and project trackers within the M&A Recruiting Toolkit, keeping them accurate and accessible across workstreams. Including the tracking sheets and liaising with internal teams to monitor job placement progress for transitional employees post-acquisition.
* Assist the Program Manager with data reconciliation: extracting candidate data, mapping acquired employee profiles, updating requisition statuses, and archiving legacy ATS information where applicable.
Schedule alignment sessions, risk reviews, and touchpoints across ES M&A, Talent Acquisition, and acquired leadership teams. Prepare regular status reports, track deliverables against timelines, and aggregate M&A recruiting risk metrics for leadership reviews.  

**Minimum Requirements**

* 2–4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Recruiting Coordination, or Project Management support roles. Previous experience supporting M&A deals, HR system integrations, or complex cross-functional HR projects is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) like Workday Recruiting or similar HRIS tools.
* Advanced working knowledge of Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides) or Microsoft Office, with strong data manipulation and reporting accuracy.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to follow detailed project plans, flag risks early, maintain organized documentation, and interact comfortably with acquired company points of contact and internal team leads.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of global recruiting processes, offer letters, and compliance guidelines.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity in fast-paced transaction environments.

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Our Customer Experience team owns the full post-sales lifecycle for one of Rippling’s largest business units, from onboarding and implementation to escalations and renewals—we’re united by a passion for customers and continuous improvement, and we’re committed to personal and professional growth.

In this role, you're expected to be a builder: you’ll design and run the post-sales operating model for the business unit from the ground up. Our model runs on a lean, task-based system where every motion is defined, measured, and repeatable. You’ll define what success looks like, set the KPIs, map and build the workflows, write the playbooks, and keep refining the machine as the business grows.

You will also bridge data and day-to-day execution: building multi-factor health scores, engineering automated risk interventions, refining lifecycle touch points across the whole Product Experience to maximize retention outcomes.

Last, you’ll be the technical architect of the systems behind it and be the main business partner to CX leadership. You’ll find the truth in the data, turn it into action, and own the outcome.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Build the post-sales operating model for the business unit: define success at each lifecycle stage, set the KPIs, and design how work flows across onboarding, implementation, customer success, escalations, and renewals.
* Own the architecture, data integrity, and configuration of our CX systems. Partner cross-functionally on integrations across CRM, billing, support, and product analytics.
* Analyze intervention outcomes to understand why accounts churn or save, and use what you learn to refine playbooks and train the team on save and de-escalation strategies.
* Establish automated early warning systems that detect leading indicators of churn well before renewal windows open.
* Develop proactive intervention playbooks mapped to specific risk triggers (e.g., missed payments, steep drops in platform activity, repeated support escalations).
* Own the customer sentiment program (NPS, CSAT): build and administer lifecycle-triggered surveys, analyze trends across customer segments, and run a closed-loop detractor playbook.
* Prepare and run weekly business reviews, and deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting on gross and net retention, save rates, health score trends, and operational capacity.
* Manage and mentor a team of Retention Specialists through regular 1:1s, performance coaching, and workflow reviews. Set the SOPs, turnaround targets, and escalation protocols they work from.
* Partner with Product, Sales, and Support to surface upstream product frictions, onboarding bottlenecks, or misaligned customer expectations that contribute to churn.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **A builder.** You want to build the right system or workflow rather than inherit it; you’re comfortable in ambiguity, and you’ve done that before.
* **An owner.** When you see a problem, you act with urgency and you proactively own it until it’s solved; you are effective as a cross-functional operator.
* **A truth seeker.** You go to the data and to the frontline, you challenge assumptions (including your own), and make decisions based on what’s actually happening.
* **Thorough.** You sweat the details in workflows, data, and documentation, because a system is only as good as its details. You keep making the process better.

**What you will have**
----------------------

* 3–10+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, RevOps, or CX Management within a B2B SaaS environment.
* 1+ years of direct people management or lead experience guiding retention, support, or customer success specialists.
* Experience building operations from the ground up in a high-growth environment.
* Track record of designing retention programs, renewal/save programs, and/or building automated risk-alert frameworks tied directly to measurable retention gains.
* Technical comfort owning and building systems; You're comfortable with SFDC, Jira, and/or CSP platforms (e.g. Vitally, Gainsight or ChurnZero), navigating API integrations, bi-directional syncing, and event-based tracking schemas.
* Strong data literacy; proficient in mapping SaaS metrics (NRR, GRR, Churn, LTV, Adoption velocity) and synthesizing raw analytics into operational priorities.
* Emerging AI Tooling Experience: you are comfortable integrating LLMs (e.g., Claude, OpenAI APIs) into CX tech stacks for automated ticket summarization, health score analysis, or retention playbook drafting.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Global Partners
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Technical Program Manager in our Business Engineering team to deepen the relationship between Meta and the world's largest advertisers and agencies. Our biggest clients no longer come to us only to buy media; they come to re-architect how they operate, and they expect a partner who can help them plan that journey, frame it for their own leadership, and then see it through. In this role you will work alongside the client teams who own our largest global accounts and agencies, bringing an enterprise lens to each relationship: understanding what the client is already doing with Meta, diagnosing where their real constraints sit, shaping the small number of ambitious projects worth doing together, and program managing them to delivery.This is a client-facing, hands-on role for an operator who thinks like a consultant. You will spend significant time with clients and agencies, and significant time behind the scenes designing the workshops, pre-reads, project frames and trackers that turn executive intent into committed work. You will not carry a quota or a book of business; your impact comes through the client and agency teams you support, and through your ability to make complex, multi-party programs actually land. The work spans Meta's portfolio of products, including business messaging, business AI agents, our models and ads offerings, and you will help account teams speak credibly about all of it.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Global Partners Responsibilities:**

* Lead cross-functional Business Engineering, Marketing Science and Creative Shop programs for Meta's largest global clients and agencies, acting as the "COO" to drive operational excellence and program outcomes
* Partner with client teams to build and maintain an enterprise view of each relationship: what is live, what is stalled, where the commercial and technical dependencies sit, and what the client's own organisation will and will not support
* Diagnose each client's situation from first principles, including their business priorities, public commitments, technology estate and internal decision-making structure, and translate that into a small number of high-conviction enterprise opportunities
* Rapidly translate client insight into Meta's product roadmap, leveraging prototypes to validate, iterate, and scale solutions that address client needs
* Our enterprise workshops and executive sessions end-to-end: define the objective and success criteria, recommend the content and provocations to the client team, build the pre-reads, design the agenda and breakouts, secure the right attendees on both sides, and run the session
* Program manage everything the client agrees to: convert workshop outcomes into scoped workstreams with named owners on both sides, milestones, dependencies and a live view of barriers and blockers, and drive them to a defined outcome
* Develop and manage end-to-end program plans, ensuring on-time delivery and high-quality execution across all phases of the program lifecycle
* Partner closely with engineering, product and business teams to clarify requirements, align on priorities, and ensure solutions are delivered to meet business objectives
* Coordinate the internal teams a program depends on, including enterprise technical sales specialists, business engineering, product, marketing, legal, privacy and partnerships, without owning their deliverables
* Identify and proactively mitigate risks, streamline execution, and scale best practices to maximise productivity and impact across programs — including the organisational risks that stall enterprise work, such as absent senior ownership on the client side, competing mandates between marketing, media, procurement and technology, and the absence of precedent for first-of-a-kind work
* Collaborate with legal, policy and compliance teams to ensure all solutions and partnerships adhere to local and global regulations, maintaining the highest standards of integrity and trust
* Frame enterprise opportunities so they are defensible to leadership on both sides, including the mutual value, the commitment required from each party, and the criteria that make a project worth doing at all
* Equip account teams to hold credible enterprise conversations across Meta's enterprise portfolio, and prepare them and their clients' executives for those conversations
* Bring client and agency reality back into Meta, including product gaps and enterprise-readiness constraints across security, legal and support
* Define, track and report on program OKRs, KPIs and success metrics, ensuring transparency, accountability and continuous improvement in program delivery and client value
* Capture what is learned on each engagement so the approach becomes repeatable across the portfolio rather than dependent on any single relationship

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in program management, enterprise engagement management, management consulting, digital advertising, business engineering, or a related field
* Experience owning complex, multi-stakeholder programs end-to-end, from diagnosis and framing through to delivery, in environments without an established playbook
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional programs in a matrixed, global organisation, with a track record of delivering complex projects on time and at scale
* Demonstrated experience in designing and facilitating executive workshops and working sessions that produce committed decisions rather than discussions
* Experience working directly with senior client stakeholders, including C-level and functional leadership across marketing, technology, and procurement
* Experience diagnosing a client organisation's structure and decision-making dynamics, and building a path forward that accounts for them
* Proven ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams you do not manage, in ambiguous and highly matrixed environments
* Experience prioritizing competing work

Tesla is looking for a Process System Technical Project Manager experienced in design, scoping, scheduling, execution, and turnover of commissioning projects for a solar cell semi-conductor fabrication facility. This role specializes in process plant design review, commissioning, optimization, process related calculations, simulation, troubleshooting, safety reviews, and on-site support. Utilities include bulk fluid process systems, cryogenic, chemical, hydrogen, steam, and other systems associated with semi-conductor fabrication. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical operations background with plant startup, isolation, management of change, commissioning, process design, and optimization. Design experience producing deliverable such as process calculations, simulations, P&IDs, equipment sizing, sequences of operation, and operational procedures is required. The candidate will coordinate commissioning, transition to operations, and improvements through product qualification. Working experience with OSHA PSM regulated systems and HAZOPs is required. With respect to project management, you will be responsible for owning commissioning project scheduling, personnel management, budget, design reviews, risk management, procurement coordination, planning work, managing work in the field, and troubleshooting system performance issues. The Amazon Devices Beta (ADB) Team is your hall pass to play at work!! We are responsible for the “real world validation” for Kindle eReaders, Fire Tablets, FireTV products, and Emerging products…think, Amazon Smart Oven and Amazon Basics Microwave. How do we do this? **Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure**

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

You will run the day-to-day operating rhythm of Crux's technology organization and keep the programs that cut across it on track. Reporting to our CTPO, you will build and maintain the integrated plan for how Compute, Networking, Security, AI Ops, and ServerOps deliver our first production TPU clusters, and you will be the person who knows what is on track, what is at risk, and who needs to make a decision to fix it. You will run the working-level program cadence with Google, connect engineering milestones to the capacity plan of record and to customer commitments, and keep the CTPO's priorities moving while the organization is still being built. This is a builder's seat: you build the plans, the dashboards, and the tools yourself.

**In this role, you will:**

* Build and maintain the integrated technology plan for the first builds: milestones, dependencies, and readiness gates across Compute, Networking, Security, AI Ops, and ServerOps, from cluster design through customer handoff.
* Run the technical program cadence with Google on TPU hardware, software, and services delivery, and track action items and commitments on both sides.
* Work with Capacity Delivery, Data Center Engineering, and the Development program managers where site delivery hands off to cluster bring-up, so that every handoff from rack-ready to customer-ready is tracked against the committed date.
* Run the CTPO operating rhythm: weekly reviews, quarterly planning inputs, and goal tracking. Prepare the materials for executive and board updates.
* Surface risks early and bring them to the right owner with the decision needed, the options, and a date, rather than reporting status after the fact.
* Track the CTPO hiring plan and headcount with Recruiting and Finance, and help each new team get set up as its leader arrives.
* Build the program tooling yourself: plans, dashboards, and AI-enabled workflows that keep status current without status meetings.

**SIGNALS OF SUCCESS**

**After 60 days in this role:**

* Learned the capacity plan of record, the Google partnership model, and our first customer commitments, and published the first version of the integrated technology plan for the first build.
* Stood up the CTPO weekly review and the working cadence with Google.
* Adapted to a fast-paced environment, triaging appropriately and continuously improving our function.

**After 6 months:**

* Kept the integrated plan current through the first production TPU cluster delivery, with readiness gates that caught issues before they became delays.
* Become the place leadership goes first for an accurate read on technology delivery status, risks, and open decisions.
* Demonstrated an AI-forward and automated approach to this role: you have built, in a hands-on way, AI-enabled tools for planning, tracking, or reporting that the team uses every day.

**After 1 year:**

* Turned the lessons from the first build into a repeatable delivery playbook for the next sites.
* Kept execution steady as the CTPO organization grew from its first leaders to a full team.
* Become a trusted partner to the CTPO and engineering leads on keeping priorities and tradeoffs visible.

**EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH**

**Experiences**

* 7+ years in technical program management, including 3+ years on cross-functional programs for large-scale infrastructure at a hyperscaler, neocloud, or data center operator.
* Delivered programs that spanned hardware, network, and software, such as new cluster or region launches, new hardware introductions, or data center bring-ups, against hard dates.
* Experience working with senior leaders and external partners, including running workstreams in a joint program with a strategic technology partner.

**Attributes**

* You are outcome driven and hands-on. You build your own plans, dashboards, and tools, and you use AI and automation by default. This is a builder's seat, not a supervisory one.
* You are technical enough to be useful. You can follow an engineering tradeoff on fabric design or cluster bring-up and know which question to ask.
* You have a high tolerance for ambiguity. You absorb ambiguity and navigate complexity rather than passing it along.

**Mindset**

* You are skeptical by default. "On track" is a hypothesis until the dependency owner shows you the evidence.
* You deliver through discipline, not heroics. You build the process that makes the next launch boring.
* You are AI-agentic first. Fluent with AI agents, or committed to becoming so quickly, you embed them as first principles in how you and your team work, defaulting to agentic workflows before adding headcount or process.

**Nice to have (Preferred, not required):**

* Technical program management at a hyperscaler (Google, Meta, Microsoft, AWS) or a neocloud (CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe).
* Experience delivering TPU, GPU, or other accelerator clusters, including new product introduction.
* Experience in an office of the CTO, chief of staff, or business operations role supporting a technology executive.
* Familiarity with data center power, cooling, and capacity planning.
* An engineering degree, or a PMP or similar program management certification.

Title: Quality Assurance Technician

ABOUT PETIT POT

Petit Pot is a growing food manufacturing company based in Emeryville, CA. We produce high-quality French-inspired desserts and are proud to be a Certified B Corporation, balancing purpose and profit while considering the impact of our decisions on our employees, customers, community, and the environment.

POSITION SUMMARY

The QA Technician is responsible for ensuring that all production paperwork is completed, collected, organized, reviewed, and filed to the satisfaction of all pertinent regulatory agencies and customers. Ensure the site is always audit-ready by maintaining GMP, Organic, SQF, and any other certifications. Ensure the quality of all incoming ingredients, batches, and finished products. Perform required quality testing of products and records accurate product specifications in a timely manner. The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of food safety protocols, quality control processes, and regulatory compliance in the food manufacturing industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Maintain a solid and up-to-date understanding of all regulatory issues pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.

- Maintain a solid and up-to-date understanding of all customer requirements and preferences pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.

- Collect all production paperwork, ensuring that any missing paperwork is located.

- Provide aggressive reporting and retraining for all incomplete, incorrect, or non-compliant paperwork.

- Organize paperwork per established filing system.

- Review paperwork, ensuring that all process CCP’s, quality specifications, and customer requirements have been met. Any product affected by deviations or missing records must be reported to QA Manager and placed on QA hold.

- Manage filing systems such that all completed and reviewed records are maintained and accessible for the time required by customers and regulatory agencies.

- Release product.

- Provide assistance/support as needed with the customer, government, and third-party audits.

- Ensure all products meet the customer and product requirements.

- Always keep all work areas and equipment within SQF standards and clean.

- Ensure all personal protective equipment is always properly worn.

- Ensure all equipment is set up, calibrated, and functioning properly throughout your shift.

- Keep all equipment that is used clean, in your area always, and prepared for the next run.

- Perform several checks to the batches such as Color, pH & sensory, vacuum and % solid.

- Obtain batch samples by opening kettles, turning off agitators, ladle the samples, place samples in beakers, and take them to QC Bench for testing.

- Obtain liquid ingredient samples from bulk containers and perform testing on them.

- Recommend adjustments be made to batches by adding or subtracting ingredients.

- Monitor the Filler Machine and lines by checking the weights, charts, codes, labeling, pasteurizer temperatures and perform hourly finished product analysis.

- Verify codes and charts very closely - the ink can run dry and codes can be set wrong.

- Perform visual checks and record results, weigh product on calibrated scales, obtain and bring the samples to the QC bench for testing, perform tests, and record results.

- Place batches of finished products on hold as required.

- Copy batch cards as required for kitchen operators.

- All other assigned duties required during your work period.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- GED or High School Diploma

- Previous QA experience in a food manufacturing environment.

- Ability to work with numbers, perform calculations, and possess mechanical abilities.

- Ability to identify food safety concerns or risks.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently, with limited supervision.

- Communication skills: must be able to communicate and work closely with all departments and management levels.

- Keep up with a fast-paced work environment and record data as required in a timely manner.

- Extreme attention to detail.

- Strong organizational ability.

- Good communication skills (both written and verbal).

- General computer proficiency (Word, Excel, etc.).

- Ability to attend and successfully complete related training programs.

- Spanish (Plus, not required)

EQUIPMENT AND TOOLS USED

- Use the following equipment: Refractometer, Salt Titrator, Acid Titrator, PH Meter, Color Meter, Moisture Meter, Viscometer, and Consistometer, various gages, torque meters and other equipment as required.

- Handcarts and pallet jacks.

- Forklift (not all QC Techs.)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- SQF Certified (Plus, not required)

- PCQI Certified (Plus, not required)

- HACCP Certified (Plus, not required)

- Experience in the food manufacturing industry required.

- Knowledge of food safety regulations, quality standards, and production best practices.

- Experience with lean manufacturing, process improvement, or waste reduction is a plus.

- Experience in dessert, dairy, pudding, or refrigerated food production is a plus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

- Varied temperature work areas.

- The environment is very wet, slippery, and has continuous forklift traffic.

- Handle and work around various moving equipment and chemicals.

- Frequent use of hot/cold water to perform checks and clean equipment and area.

- Frequent lifting objects < 30 lbs. and pushing/pulling of objects less than <80 lbs. on carts.

- Long term standing, constantly moving around on foot, frequent bending, and constant climbing of stairs. (Mus

Thistle delivers fully prepared, healthy-by-default meals, snacks, desserts, and organic cold-pressed juices. We’re building a future where nutritious, sustainable food is accessible, craveable, and part of everyday life.

The Food Safety & Quality Assurance Supervisor oversees aspects of Quality Management Systems, food safety regulatory Compliance, 3rd Party Food Safety certifications, and Customer Safety & Satisfaction. The FSQA Supervisor is responsible for conducting audits in accordance with food safety and quality management systems. They will collaborate with teams to generate and implement key initiatives aimed at protecting and enhancing the quality of food products at Thistle. The FSQA Supervisor is responsible for overseeing standardized quality control checks to ensure they meet the required legal and company standards for food safety and quality. **About Rivet**  
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.  
  
We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.  
  
At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.  
  
**Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).**

**Summary**

Rivet Industries builds rugged hardware and software for defense and industrial frontline workers. We are looking for an experienced Quality Manager to build and lead quality across the company, from the first prototype through shipped product in the field.

This is the first dedicated quality leadership role at Rivet. You will own the quality system end to end, grow a small team, and set the standard our contract manufacturers, suppliers and internal teams build to. Our products are made with contract manufacturers overseas today, and we are standing up US manufacturing alongside them, so you will build a quality program that works across both.

You will lead every quality function in the org.

* Supplier quality: contract manufacturer and component supplier quality, including audits, qualification, incoming inspection, SCARs and supplier scorecards
* In-house quality engineering: inspection plans, process controls, first article inspection and line quality for our US builds
* Company quality system: the QMS itself, including ISO 9001 certification (with a path toward AS9100), document control, internal audits, CAPA and management review
* Software quality: release quality standards and test gates for the software that ships on and with our hardware, in partnership with Software
* Compliance: oversight of trade compliance, regulatory and product certifications, environmental compliance and safety

**Responsibilities**

* Define and run Rivet's quality strategy, policies and metrics, and report quality performance to Operations and executive leadership
* Build, implement and maintain a QMS that achieves ISO 9001 certification and scales toward AS9100 and defense customer requirements
* Lead supplier and contract manufacturer quality: qualification audits, quality agreements, process audits, SCARs and corrective action through closure
* Set up quality for US in-house manufacturing, including inspection, first article inspection, process controls and nonconforming material review
* Own quality gates across NPI: DFM/DFT input, PFMEA and control plans, build readiness reviews and production release criteria
* Run a closed-loop CAPA process and lead 8D investigations on significant escapes
* Partner with Software to set release quality standards and test gates for shipped software
* Oversee compliance across trade (export controls such as ITAR/EAR), product regulatory certifications, environmental (RoHS, REACH) and safety, and support customer and government audits
* Work with Engineering, Program Management, Supply Chain and Manufacturing to make quality a design and build requirement, not an end-of-line check
* Hire, develop and lead a team of quality, reliability and compliance engineers as the company grows

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field
* 10+ years in quality engineering or quality management for electronic or electromechanical hardware
* 5+ years leading quality teams or a quality function
* Hands-on experience managing contract manufacturers and suppliers, including overseas (Asia) manufacturing
* Experience building or running an ISO 9001 QMS and leading a company through certification or surveillance audits
* Deep working knowledge of quality tools: FMEA, control plans, SPC, MSA, first article inspection, 8D and root cause analysis
* Experience taking products from NPI through volume production
* Ability to work across engineering, operations and leadership, and to set direction without a large existing team
* Willingness to travel to contract manufacturers and suppliers (domestic and international)
* Ability to meet U.S. export control (ITAR) requirements

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in defense, aerospace or other regulated hardware (AS9100, MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461, DFARS flow-downs)
* Startup or early-stage experience building a quality function from the ground up
* Experience standing up a new US factory or production line
* Familiarity with IPC-A-610 / J-STD-001 workmanship standards
* Experience with export, environmental and product certification programs
* Experience with a PLM/QMS system (for example Arena)
* ASQ certification (CQE, CQM/OE or CRE) or Six Sigma Black Belt

jobs.description:
**Description**

**About CoreSite:**

CoreSite is a leading colocation data center company providing the space, power, cooling and connectivity that businesses rely on to operate and grow. Our data centers bring dozens of organizations together under one roof, supporting the technology and services that keep our world connected. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, bringing the expertise, ideas and commitment that power our business and help our customers succeed. With a culture built on collaboration, ownership, and operational excellence, CoreSite is a place to make an impact.

**Commissioning Program Manager - Data Center:**

As a member of the company's Engineering team, the Commissioning Program Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of commissioning activities across data center projects, including greenfield builds, expansions, and system upgrades. This role ensures that all mechanical, electrical, and control systems are designed, installed, tested, and validated to meet performance, quality, and operational readiness requirements. You will collaborate closely with design teams, contractors, commissioning authorities, operations, and cross‑functional stakeholders to oversee commissioning plans, testing protocols, documentation, and issue resolution. This role requires technical leadership, strong project management capability, and deep fluency in mission‑critical systems and commissioning standards.

**What You'll Do:**

**Commissioning Management & Execution:**

* As the owner's representative, oversee Level 1-5 commissioning reviews and execution, ensuring testing validates performance against specifications.
* Oversee the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of internal commissioning standards, procedures, SOWs, and NETA standards.
* Participate in system integration testing to ensure seamless operation across all critical systems.

**Project Management & Coordination:**

* Support commissioning activities, scopes, and stakeholder communications throughout the project lifecycle.
* Coordinate directly with general contractors, subcontractors, engineers of record, internal stakeholders, commissioning authorities (CxAs), and vendors.
* Lead the implementation of CoreSite commissioning guidelines and support CxAs in integrating commissioning activities throughout design and construction workflows.
* Provide directions to commissioning teams and act as the primary escalation point during testing and issue resolution.

**Quality Assurance & Compliance:**

* Review and standardize commissioning scripts, including templates for critical equipment, to ensure system testing meets industry standards, owner requirements, operational criteria, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Drive quality control measures for testing, inspection documentation, and issue tracking for continuous improvement.

**Documentation & Reporting:**

* Develop and maintain comprehensive system for tracking and storing commissioning documentation, including test results, reports, and as‑built records.
* Represent the owner in project commissioning meetings, communicate commissioning progress to internal stakeholders, and maintain Engineering Team alignment and engagement throughout the commissioning lifecycle.
* Manage commissioning scope definition and CxA procurement while ensuring effective onboarding, documentation management, and reporting for third-party commissioning teams.
* Promote innovation and continuous improvement in commissioning processes and tools.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Flexibility to travel up to 40%, with the potential for increased travel or in-office presence as business needs evolve.
* Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, control systems, and building automation systems (BMS/EPMS).
* Experience performing or overseeing Level 3-5 commissioning for critical infrastructure (UPS, generators, switchgear, STS/ATS, HVAC systems, etc.).
* Proficiency with commissioning and QA/QC software tools (e.g., CxAlloy, BIM360, Facility Grid, Procore).
* Excellent communication, leadership, and cross-team coordination skills.
* Strong project management capabilities including planning, scheduling, and reporting.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Construction Management, Building Services, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in data center commissioning, QA/QC, construction management, or mission critical environments
* Commissioning certification from a recognized industry authority; PMP considered an asset.
* Experience working with third party CxAs and data center development programs.

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the job's essential functions. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the job's duties, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk, sit, use hands to handle or feel objects, reach with hands and arms, climb stairs, balance, stoop or kneel, talk, and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Ability to travel is required.

**Compensation:** Compensation for this role includes a base salary between $125,400 and $155,000. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus and equity, based upon individual and company performance.

**Job Post Timeline:** This position is expected to be open for applications for 30 days.

FNS Training Club is more than a place to work out. We are a private training club built around exceptional coaching, community, culture, and connection.

Our mission is to help everyday athletes become stronger, healthier, and more confident through a personalized approach to training, nutrition, recovery, mindset, and accountability.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

### **Role Overview**

The **Account Manager** is the primary post-sales partner for clients and agencies, responsible for turning closed deals into high-performing, long-term partnerships. This role owns campaign execution, technical onboarding, continuous optimization, custom reporting, billing and identifying organic upsell and renewal opportunities.

**You Will:**

* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns at once.

**You May Also Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Marketing, Business, Data Analytics).
* Experience in the media or advertising industry.

.

Serving as a strategic business partner, this specialist demonstrates high learning agility and comfort with ambiguity to drive workforce capabilities amidst ongoing technological and organizational change.

\*\***This position requires up to 75% travel\*\*\*\***

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**
-----------------------

**Strategic Consulting & Business Alignment**

* Partners with business leaders and functional teams to diagnose performance gaps, translate organizational strategy into workforce capabilities, and recommend blended solutions.
* Aligns learning strategy objectives to ensure equitable access and career development opportunities across the workforce.

**Product Portfolio Management**

* Manages a portfolio of dynamic learning products rather than standalone courses, utilizing Agile sprints, minimum viable products (MVPs), and rapid feedback loops to pilot and iterate solutions.
* Establishes ongoing maintenance cycles and audits program relevance to support continuous learning.

**AI Fluency & Content Governance**

* Serves as the primary governance checkpoint for learning AI, supervising and validating AI-generated content for pedagogical quality, compliance, and accuracy to prevent low-quality outputs.

* Interprets learning analytics to segment learners by persona, personalize learning pathways, and build ROI-based business cases for executive stakeholders.
* Translates complex datasets into design decisions that improve learner retention and business impact.

**Technology Ecosystem Orchestration**

* Evaluates, pilots, and leverages modern learning technology stacks (LMS, xAPI, VR/AR, AI tutors) in close collaboration with IT, data teams, and subject matter experts.

**Facilitation & Change Leadership**

* Designs and delivers high-impact instructor-led, virtual, and blended learning experiences.
* Leads workforce change initiatives supporting the emotional side of digital and cultural transitions through peer cohorts and collaborative learning.

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES**
----------------------------------

* Comprehensive knowledge of adult learning theory, instructional design methodologies (ADDIE, SAM, Agile), organizational behavior, and inclusion strategies.
* Advanced expertise in course authoring tools (Articulate Storyline), LMS administration, prompt engineering, data analytics, and stakeholder management.
* High learning agility, comfort with ambiguity, executive credibility, strategic thinking, and resilience through rapid organizational transitions.

---------------------------------------------------------------------

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Organizational Development, Business, or a related field.

* Experience in Towing and/or Automotive training highly preferred

Works in an office environment sitting at a desk, table, computer workstation or standing for extended periods of time. jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Title**: BioQUEST Curriculum Consortium, Program Coordinator

**Location**: Remote, US-based

**Hours**: Part-time, averaging 10–15 hours per week

**Reports to**: Executive Director

**Compensation**: Hourly rate commensurate with experience, minimum $25 per hour

**Start Date**: December 1, 2026

Join a national community of life science educators in a flexible, part-time role you can do from anywhere in the US. This **remote position** averages 10–15 hours per week and is ideal for someone who enjoys keeping programs organized, working with partners and volunteers, and sharing the story of innovation in STEM education.

**About Us**

BioQUEST Curriculum Consortium is a transformative, collaborative community empowering life science educators to drive innovation in STEM education. For 40 years, BioQUEST has led innovation in biology education, with a continuing emphasis on effective uses of inquiry, technology, professional development, and curriculum development.

BioQUEST is a remote-first, independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit based in Rockingham County, NH, engaging a wide array of volunteer and staff leaders across the country.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and reliable **Program Coordinator** to keep BioQUEST’s professional development programs running smoothly and make sure our community hears about them. Working with staff, volunteers, and partners, you’ll coordinate the online BIOME summer workshop and semester-long faculty opportunities, and help shape the newsletters, social media, and campaigns that reach our members.

Our opportunities are led by partner and volunteer facilitators, and you’ll work with these volunteers to ensure quality. The role also works closely with representatives from professional scientific societies, externally funded education projects, and faculty special interest groups.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Professional Development Programs**

* *BIOME Summer Workshop*: Coordinate BioQUEST’s virtual BIOME summer workshop, held one week in July.
* *Year-Round Opportunities*: Coordinate BioQUEST’s other professional development opportunities.
* *Volunteer Coordination*: Support the partner and volunteer facilitators who lead our opportunities.

**Communications & Outreach**

* Organize content creation for newsletters, coordinating with partners and team members to keep messaging consistent and high quality.
* Share news, events, and resources with BioQUEST communities through social media, press releases, announcements, and blog posts.
* Highlight community successes and recognize contributors.
* Design graphics for marketing materials and update presentations for external audiences.

**Qualifications**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
* Self-motivated, proactive, reliable, flexible, and adaptable.
* Ability to work and communicate in a team environment.
* Ability to multitask, act independently, and prioritize.

Helpful but not required:

* Bachelor’s degree in STEM, marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, and social media.
* Experience in project coordination and with project management tools and methodologies.
* Experience creating content or running communications campaigns; a confident storyteller and writer.
* Familiarity with graphic design and basic HTML editing.

We know there are great candidates who won’t check all these boxes, and you might bring important skills we haven’t considered. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself.

This role is only available to candidates legally authorized to work in the United States; visa sponsorship is not provided at this time.

**Hours & Work Environment**

This **remote, part-time position** averages **10–15 hours per week** on a flexible schedule, with potential for additional hours on special projects. Though fully remote, meetings are scheduled during the workday based in Eastern Time. Expect more intensive time leading up to and during the BIOME summer workshop, held one week in July. The role includes regular BioQUEST meetings on Zoom and virtual meetings with partners as needed.

BioQUEST is a distributed organization with collaborators throughout the United States. The work includes both synchronous and asynchronous components and requires a modern computer and a stable internet connection. The job involves frequent desk work and sitting for extended periods, long periods of screen time, and regular virtual meetings.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Success in this role means BioQUEST’s professional development programs run smoothly and our community hears about them.** The BIOME summer workshop and year-round opportunities are well organized, volunteer facilitators are supported, programs stay high quality, and newsletters, social media, and announcements go out consistently and on time.

**Compensation**

Hourly rate commensurate with experience, minimum $25 per hour.

Submit a cover letter (no more than 2 pages) and resume through the online application at .

In your cover letter, please share your interest in the role and highlight the skills, qualifications, and experiences that make you a strong fit, including how your experience aligns with the responsibilities above.

Screening of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled. If you need accommodation during the application process, contact Sarah Prescott at .

jobs.title: Patient Experience Coordinator (Central Time)
jobs.description:
Heartbeat Health is the leading virtual-first cardiovascular care company in the country, providing patients with convenient, high-quality heart care through a combination of telemedicine, diagnostics, and virtual care programs. By leveraging real-time data and AI-powered insights, Heartbeat Health empowers providers and patients with personalized treatment plans, reducing hospitalizations and improving long-term heart health outcomes. Heartbeat Health is redefining how cardiovascular care is delivered in the digital age, led by our medical group of cardiologists, advanced practitioners, nurses, and care coordinators.

  

### **About the Job:**

We are seeking a Patient Experience Coordinator to join our virtual clinic team. This is a full-time, remote position requiring availability to work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Central Time (CST/CDT).

This entry-level opportunity is ideal for individuals who are passionate about delivering exceptional patient experiences and eager to grow their careers in the healthcare technology industry. As a Patient Experience Coordinator, you will serve as a key point of contact for patients, helping them navigate their cardiovascular care journey while ensuring a seamless and supportive experience.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Patient Outreach & Engagement:** Proactively connect with patients via phone, text, and email to coordinate virtual appointments, schedule diagnostic testing (such as stress tests and echocardiograms), and support ongoing patient engagement.
* **Patient Support & Experience:** Deliver a high-quality, concierge-level experience by assisting patients with technical questions, navigating virtual care platforms, and ensuring they feel informed and supported throughout their care journey.
* **Operational Support:** Maintain accurate patient information, document interactions, identify opportunities for process improvement, and support efficient daily clinic operations.
* **Collaboration & Growth:** Work closely with clinical and operational teams to improve patient workflows, support new healthcare programs, and contribute to the continued growth of our virtual care services.

### **About You:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Social Work, Communications, Education, Sociology, Psychology, Health Sciences, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:** At least 6 months of professional work or internship experience, preferably in a customer-facing or service-oriented environment.
* **Customer Service Focus:** Experience in high-touch, customer-facing roles such as hospitality, retail, food service, or call centers, with the ability to navigate fast-paced environments while maintaining professionalism and empathy.
* **People-Oriented:** Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for helping others, building relationships, and creating positive experiences.
* **Mission-Driven:** Genuine enthusiasm for supporting patients and making a meaningful impact on their healthcare experience and outcomes.
* **Tech-Savvy & Adaptable:** Comfortable navigating technology, maintaining accurate records, and learning new systems and healthcare platforms in a fast-paced, virtual environment.
* **Organization & Attention to Detail:** Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and provide timely follow-up to ensure a seamless patient experience.
* **Schedule Availability:** Ability to consistently work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Central Time (CST/CDT), regardless of location.

### **About Our Culture:**

* **We are mission-driven:** we're revolutionizing the way cardiovascular care is delivered
* **We are fast-paced & agile:** we move quickly, iterate often, and value experimentation
* **We are remote-first:** ownership, autonomy, and trust are at the core of how we operate
* **We care about diversity**: diversity allows us to build an excellent patient experience
* **We care about each other:** we are stronger together through a culture of mutual respect and active support.
* **We invest in our people:** Eligible employees have access to a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid holidays, sick time, a 401(k), and additional benefits designed to support you and your family.
* **We are an equal opportunity employer:** we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

$24 - $26 an hour

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Join the team as Twilio’s next Partner Program Manager.

**About the job**

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 30,2026, but may change based on business needs.

**Finance and Operations Manager**

**Position Summary**

Department: Operations

**About Mothers Out Front**

Mothers Out Front builds our power as mothers to ensure a livable climate for all children. We are growing a multi-racial, cross-class, intergenerational movement of mothers, grandmothers, and caregivers dedicated to convincing elected officials and business leaders to work for a swift, complete, and just transition away from fossil fuels to clean and renewable energy. We know that mothers have an important role to play in the climate justice movement, and, when it comes to protecting children, mothers are an unstoppable force for change. Our goal is simple: to enable mothers to take active leadership in climate justice work by providing the structure, training, and tools for them to work together and win campaigns in their communities, cities, and states.

The Finance and Operations Manager oversees the day-to-day administrative, human resources, and financial operations that keep our organization healthy and compliant.
