jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Our Customer Experience team owns the full post-sales lifecycle for one of Rippling’s largest business units, from onboarding and implementation to escalations and renewals—we’re united by a passion for customers and continuous improvement, and we’re committed to personal and professional growth.

In this role, you're expected to be a builder: you’ll design and run the post-sales operating model for the business unit from the ground up. Our model runs on a lean, task-based system where every motion is defined, measured, and repeatable. You’ll define what success looks like, set the KPIs, map and build the workflows, write the playbooks, and keep refining the machine as the business grows.

You will also bridge data and day-to-day execution: building multi-factor health scores, engineering automated risk interventions, refining lifecycle touch points across the whole Product Experience to maximize retention outcomes.

Last, you’ll be the technical architect of the systems behind it and be the main business partner to CX leadership. You’ll find the truth in the data, turn it into action, and own the outcome.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Build the post-sales operating model for the business unit: define success at each lifecycle stage, set the KPIs, and design how work flows across onboarding, implementation, customer success, escalations, and renewals.
* Own the architecture, data integrity, and configuration of our CX systems. Partner cross-functionally on integrations across CRM, billing, support, and product analytics.
* Analyze intervention outcomes to understand why accounts churn or save, and use what you learn to refine playbooks and train the team on save and de-escalation strategies.
* Establish automated early warning systems that detect leading indicators of churn well before renewal windows open.
* Develop proactive intervention playbooks mapped to specific risk triggers (e.g., missed payments, steep drops in platform activity, repeated support escalations).
* Own the customer sentiment program (NPS, CSAT): build and administer lifecycle-triggered surveys, analyze trends across customer segments, and run a closed-loop detractor playbook.
* Prepare and run weekly business reviews, and deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting on gross and net retention, save rates, health score trends, and operational capacity.
* Manage and mentor a team of Retention Specialists through regular 1:1s, performance coaching, and workflow reviews. Set the SOPs, turnaround targets, and escalation protocols they work from.
* Partner with Product, Sales, and Support to surface upstream product frictions, onboarding bottlenecks, or misaligned customer expectations that contribute to churn.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **A builder.** You want to build the right system or workflow rather than inherit it; you’re comfortable in ambiguity, and you’ve done that before.
* **An owner.** When you see a problem, you act with urgency and you proactively own it until it’s solved; you are effective as a cross-functional operator.
* **A truth seeker.** You go to the data and to the frontline, you challenge assumptions (including your own), and make decisions based on what’s actually happening.
* **Thorough.** You sweat the details in workflows, data, and documentation, because a system is only as good as its details. You keep making the process better.

**What you will have**
----------------------

* 3–10+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, RevOps, or CX Management within a B2B SaaS environment.
* 1+ years of direct people management or lead experience guiding retention, support, or customer success specialists.
* Experience building operations from the ground up in a high-growth environment.
* Track record of designing retention programs, renewal/save programs, and/or building automated risk-alert frameworks tied directly to measurable retention gains.
* Technical comfort owning and building systems; You're comfortable with SFDC, Jira, and/or CSP platforms (e.g. Vitally, Gainsight or ChurnZero), navigating API integrations, bi-directional syncing, and event-based tracking schemas.
* Strong data literacy; proficient in mapping SaaS metrics (NRR, GRR, Churn, LTV, Adoption velocity) and synthesizing raw analytics into operational priorities.
* Emerging AI Tooling Experience: you are comfortable integrating LLMs (e.g., Claude, OpenAI APIs) into CX tech stacks for automated ticket summarization, health score analysis, or retention playbook drafting.

**Additional Information**

jobs.description:
Southern Hobby Distribution, LLC was founded in 1991 with one simple goal: to become our customers’ greatest asset by delivering top-quality products, unmatched customer service, and the most knowledgeable sales staff in the hobby industry.

Southern Hobby Distribution is a Collectivus Holdings company, serving retailers and collectors across the hobby and collectibles industry.

Southern Hobby Distribution is seeking a Purchasing Operations Manager to oversee its buying function, with direct management responsibility for all SHD Buyers and accountability for purchasing execution, inventory performance, and day-to-day vendor relationships.

The Buying Leader partners closely with the EVP, Product on category direction, assortment priorities, significant inventory investments, and strategic vendor matters. The role translates agreed priorities into actionable purchasing plans and holds the buying team accountable for results.

Working with Sales, Finance, Warehouse Operations, and Technology, this leader balances product availability and customer demand with margin, cash flow, and inventory discipline.

**About Claim Warriors**

Claim Warriors (www.claimwarriors.com) is a rapidly growing residential and commercial insurance public adjusting firm, operating across 18 states and expanding into new markets. We advocate for property owners facing denied, underpaid, and complex insurance claims, combining claims expertise, detailed documentation, and persistent negotiation to help clients secure the settlements they deserve.

In just two years, we have grown to more than 70 team members. We are looking for an organized, decisive Operations Manager to strengthen our processes, hold teams accountable, and help scale our claims operations.

**About the Role**

You will oversee operations after marketing and sales, taking ownership of how claims move from client onboarding through inspections, estimates, negotiations, attorney referrals when necessary, and payment.

This role requires a strong understanding of the full property insurance claim lifecycle. Your primary focus will be managing and scaling onboarding and claims workflows, reducing turnaround times, and ensuring every file has an accountable owner and a clear next step.

You will work closely with our Claims Manager, Claim Consultants, Inspection Dispatcher, in-house and outsourced inspectors, attorney partners, Customer Support team, and three Virtual Project Managers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Onboarding & File Readiness**

* Manage and scale the onboarding process as claim volume grows.
* Ensure each file contains the required agreements, policies, carrier correspondence, photographs, payment information, and supporting documentation.

* Identify missing information early and ensure it is obtained promptly.
* Set expectations for onboarding turnaround times and hold the team accountable for meeting them.

**Inspections & Dispatch**

* Oversee inspection scheduling and completion through our Inspection Dispatcher.
* Coordinate assignments and capacity across in-house inspectors and outsourced inspection partners.
* Ensure inspections produce complete, timely photographs, reports, and supporting documentation.
* Resolve scheduling delays, missed appointments, and quality issues that could slow claim progression.

**Estimates, Negotiations & Claim Progression**

* Manage estimating and negotiation workflows with our Claims Manager and in-house Claim Consultants.

* Hold teams accountable for timely follow-up, accurate documentation, and consistent progress.
* Identify stalled files, resolve bottlenecks, and escalate issues when necessary.
* Track settlement and payment milestones through completion.

* Coordinate with the Claims Manager to identify files requiring attorney involvement and ensure timely referrals.
* Oversee complete, organized handoffs to attorney partners, including claim history, estimates, carrier correspondence, and supporting documentation.
* Track referrals through attorney onboarding and follow up on outstanding requirements.
* Coordinate requests for additional reports, photographs, estimates, and other information.
* Maintain clear ownership and communication between internal teams and attorney partners.

**Customer Support & Issue Resolution**

* Oversee the Customer Support team and establish clear standards for responsiveness and follow-through.

* Ensure clients receive accurate updates and understand the next steps in their claims.
* Hold team members accountable for unanswered questions and overdue requests.
* Use recurring client issues to identify and correct operational weaknesses.

**Team Management, Accountability & Scaling**

* Manage and support three Virtual Project Managers and the operational teams involved in claim progression.
* Establish clear responsibilities, priorities, deadlines, and performance expectations.
* Build and improve procedures that support consistent execution as the company grows.
* Monitor onboarding speed, inspection completion, file aging, negotiation turnaround, attorney handoffs, and unresolved customer requests.
* Provide leadership with clear reporting on performance, bottlenecks, and staffing needs.
* Adjust workflows and priorities as business needs change.

**Qualifications**

* Strong working knowledge of the full residential and commercial property insurance claim lifecycle, from onboarding through settlement and payment.
* Experience managing operations or teams within public adjusting, property insurance claims, or a closely related business.
* Understanding of inspections, estimating, claim documentation, carrier negotiations, and attorney referral processes.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple teams, competing priorities, and a high volume of active files.
* Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.
* Experience using CRM and workflow systems to track files, monitor performance, and maintain accountability.
* Ability to establish clear expectations, address missed deadlines, and drive work through completion.
* Comfort managing remote employees and outside partners.

You are an organized operator who brings structure, urgency, and accountability. You notice when a file stops moving, determine why, and make sure the next step happens. You can lead people, improve processes, and step in directly when an issue needs attention.

Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

**Make an impact — from near or far**

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.

**The opportunity**

The AI Delivery and Operations Lead reports directly to the Assistant Vice President of AI Engineering and leads how SNHU's AI Engineering team plans, coordinates and delivers its work. AI Engineering builds AI software, from LLM applications and agents to the shared platform they run on, in small teams called pods; each pod pairs AI Engineering with the business team that owns the problem. Reporting to the AVP, AI Engineering, the Lead owns the team's operating rhythm, leads delivery of assigned pod initiatives from intake to production, and keeps goals, decisions, risks, and dependencies visible to pods, leadership, and the university IT, security, and AI governance teams that pod work depends on.

Success depends on the ability to create clarity from ambiguity, exercise sound judgment, influence without direct authority, and follow work through to outcomes. The role calls for enough AI and software fluency to follow engineering trade-offs and question them, but does not require building AI systems.

  
  

You will work 100% remotely in this role. #LI-Remote

* **Pod delivery plans:** Lead delivery of assigned priority pod initiatives from intake and scoping through build and launch, building integrated plans with clear scope, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, and success measures across pods, university IT, the AI governance team, and business teams.

Cofactr is on a mission to empower those who get the critical work done. We're bridging the gaps left by traditional supply chain management solutions, creating a seamless link between Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) through our innovative BOM to Build Platform, specifically tailored for hardware innovators. Our platform revolutionizes the technical hardware supply chain by ensuring it is precise, efficient, and effortlessly manageable. As a proud member of the Y Combinator W22 cohort, we've seen our revenue grow consistently, supported by substantial venture funding from esteemed VCs, including Bain Capital Ventures, including our most recent Series A capital raise of $17.2M.

  

**The Team**

The Cofactr team is innovative, creative, and collaborative, with diverse professional backgrounds and a passion for solving big problems. We’re hiring team members who are energized by the opportunity to make one of the most complex challenges in the world, the global electronics supply chain, into a scalable and intuitive tool. We value transparency and trust among our team and translate this approach into our evolving product.

  

**The Role**

The Sr. Onboarding Project Specialist owns the project management of every new Cofactr customer onboarding, from the moment Sales hands off a closed deal (starting at the end of the sales cycle) through the CSM-led enablement sessions that get the customer's team using the platform. You will run several onboardings at once, each with its own timeline, stakeholders, and configuration requirements, and keep every one of them moving. The value of this role is improving time to value for every new customer while giving them an excellent onboarding experience and making sure they achieve the outcomes they came to Cofactr for. You will get customers from signed contract to configured, enabled, and placing orders faster, without cutting corners on the setup or the relationship.

You are the coordinator between Sales, Customer Success, and the customer. You review what Sales captured in discovery, close the gaps before configuration starts, drive account setup to completion, and line up the enablement sessions our CSMs lead. Your work lets CSMs spend their time on enablement and account growth instead of logistics, and it gets customers to their first purchase (major value milestone) faster. This role requires ***operational rigor***, a **project management mindset**, **strong communication skills**, **cross functional relationship building**, and the discipline to track many concurrent projects without letting one stall.

* **Sales-to-CS Handoff:** Own the handoff for every new customer. Review the configuration discovery and intake materials from Sales, identify missing requirements, and resolve open questions with Sales and the customer before work begins. Close the knowledge gap.

* **Enablement Coordination:** Schedule and prepare CSM-led enablement sessions and office hours, including attendees, agendas, and customer pre-work, so the CSM can focus on delivering the session and the customer arrives ready.
* **Customer Communication:** Keep customers informed and accountable throughout onboarding with clear next steps, timelines, and recaps.
* **Documentation and Systems:** Keep onboarding records current in our systems (Notion, Salesforce, Pylon) so Sales, CS, and leadership can see where every customer stands.
* **Process Improvement:** Work with CS leadership to refine onboarding playbooks, intake forms, checklists, and templates as volume grows.
* **Metrics and Reporting:** Track onboarding metrics such as time from close to configuration complete, time to first enablement session, time to first purchase, and number of onboardings in flight, and use them to find and remove delays.

  + Extra credit for supply chain, procurement, or hardware/manufacturing industry experience

* **Concurrent Project Management:** A track record of running multiple customer projects at once, each with its own timeline, stakeholders, and milestones.
* **Organization and Follow-Through:** You keep a clean tracker, run tight meetings, and close loops without being reminded.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication with customers and internal teams, including the ability to push for decisions and hold stakeholders to dates.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfortable learning and configuring SaaS platforms, and able to diagnose a setup issue well enough to route it to the right person.

* **Adaptability:** Comfortable in an early-stage environment where processes are still being built.

jobs.description:
Manager, Quality Assurance - Revenue Cycle Operations - US Healthcare - Remote
  
  
Strivant Health is a fast-growing Medical Billing/Revenue Cycle Management company. We partner with physician practices to improve revenue cycle operations by optimizing people, processes, and technology. We provide Medical Billing, Collections, Call Centers, Cash Applications, Patient Access, Authorizations, Credentialing, and Analytics designed to maximize our provider clients’ revenue. This allows our client providers to stay focused on the practice of medicine rather than the business of medicine. We have worked with over 10,000 providers representing 32+ specialties and over 30+ technology platforms in our 20+ years of business.
  
  
Strivant Health is seeking an experienced Manager, Quality Assurance – Revenue Cycle Operations to lead and strengthen our quality assurance program across multiple healthcare revenue cycle clients.
  
  
This role goes beyond managing audits and reporting results. The Manager will build a structured, proactive quality program that identifies performance risks, uncovers trends, drives measurable improvement, and helps ensure we consistently meet client expectations.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong healthcare revenue cycle expertise with quality assurance leadership, data analysis, and process improvement experience. This individual will partner closely with Operations and Training to strengthen accountability, improve performance, and identify quality concerns before they become client escalations.
  
What You'll Handle
  
  
Lead the QA program across multiple RCM clients, establishing consistent processes, reporting, accountability, and oversight while supporting client-specific requirements.
  
  
Develop and manage audit methodologies, including audit frequency, sampling, scoring, pass/fail standards, and graduation and regression criteria based on demonstrated performance.
  
  
Monitor quality performance and trends, identifying recurring errors, areas of risk, and opportunities for coaching, training, and process improvement.
  
  
Establish structured audit graduation that aligns audit frequency with demonstrated employee performance and quality results.
  
  
Develop meaningful QA reporting and dashboards that provide leadership with visibility into quality scores, audit volumes, failure rates, recurring issues, and improvement trends.
  
  
Partner with Operations leadership and Training to translate audit findings into corrective actions, coaching, training, and measurable performance improvement.
  
  
Lead root cause analysis to determine whether quality issues are driven by employee performance, training gaps, unclear procedures, system limitations, or process deficiencies.
  
  
Proactively identify quality risks and improvement opportunities, addressing concerns internally before they result in client escalations.
  
  
Manage client-provided audit findings, ensuring results are reviewed, tracked, communicated, and incorporated into internal quality initiatives.
  
  
Prepare for and participate in client quality reviews, presenting performance trends, corrective actions, progress updates, and recommendations.
  
  
Identify opportunities to automate and streamline QA processes, reducing manual tracking and improving the efficiency, consistency, and accuracy of reporting.
  
  
Drive accountability and follow-through, ensuring recurring quality issues have documented action plans and that corrective actions result in measurable improvement.
  
  
Promote consistency and continuous improvement across clients, teams, and revenue cycle functions.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
  
5+ years of healthcare RCM experience with a background in quality assurance, auditing, or performance improvement.
  
  
Demonstrated experience leading or improving RCM QA programs and audit processes.
  
  
Strong knowledge of RCM workflows, quality metrics, scorecards, and root cause analysis.
  
  
Strong Excel and reporting skills; Power BI experience preferred.
  
  
Proven ability to turn quality data into actionable performance improvements.
  
  
Strong leadership, communication, and client-facing skills.
  
  
Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  
  
Experience with healthcare billing systems and Microsoft Office applications.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Success in this role means creating greater visibility, consistency, and accountability across our quality program. The Manager will help move QA from a reactive approach to one that proactively identifies risk, strengthens employee performance, improves processes, and provides clients and leadership with confidence in the quality of our revenue cycle operations.
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
Quality is more than an audit score. It directly affects our clients, our teams, and revenue cycle performance. This role provides an opportunity to shape how quality is measured and managed across multiple RCM operations while building processes that support continuous improvement and sustainable performance.
  
  
Why Strivant Health?
  
At Strivant, your work directly impacts the healthcare organizations we support and the patients they serve. As a Manager of Quality Assurance, you will help shape best-in-class revenue cycle practices while working with a collaborative, forward-thinking team. We value innovation, accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement because we know that strong global operations is the backbone of revenue cycle success.
  
  
You’ll work directly with executive leadership on high-visibility initiatives.
  
  
United States-based remote role with meaningful cross-continental collaboration.

jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Manager - USA
jobs.description:
#### **Help make the world more hospitable**

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building.

If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here.

#### **About the role**

Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You will own the customer relationship from handover to go-live, guiding hotels through setup, training and rollout so the platform works for them from day one. Each go-live is the first real test of whether Mews fits the way a property runs, and the quality of that experience shapes whether a customer stays and grows with us. Mews serves hotels across EMEA, and the portfolio is large enough that how well you onboard is felt in the numbers.

As a Customer Onboarding Manager, you run several mid-market and enterprise implementations at the same time, often phased across multiple properties or regions. You work with customer stakeholders on one side and with Sales, Support and RevOps on the other, so that what was agreed in the sale is what gets delivered at go-live.

The problem this role solves sits in the period between signing and a working go-live. Configuration choices, integration issues and timeline slips that surface late are costly for the customer and for us. You spot them early, make risk-informed trade-offs, and give customers credible advice on setup so they adopt the product and are ready to run on it.

**What you would do**

* Run several onboarding projects at once, at different stages and levels of complexity, within SLA targets, including phased rollouts across multiple properties and regions
* Configure the product for each customer, diagnose integration issues, and advise on setup decisions, flagging configuration, data and timeline risks early
* Train customer stakeholders with different needs, drive adoption through to go-live, and keep Sales, Support and RevOps aligned along the way
* Use AI to draft documentation, prepare for customer sessions and keep project tracking efficient
* Check AI-generated material for accuracy before it reaches a customer or colleague, and share what works with the team

**AI Fluency Level 2:** In this role, AI is part of your regular working week, for example drafting customer documentation, preparing for training sessions and keeping project tracking tidy, and it makes you noticeably faster and better at onboarding work. Just as important, you check what it gives you: you read it critically, correct it, and only share it with a customer or colleague once you are sure it is accurate.

*For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to* *AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates* *on Confluence.*

**What you would bring**

* 3 to 5 years in SaaS onboarding, implementation or customer-facing technical roles
* Experience managing concurrent mid-market or enterprise implementations, including phased rollouts across multiple properties or regions
* Deep SaaS product knowledge: you can configure complex products, diagnose integration issues and advise customers credibly on setup decisions
* Strong communication and training skills for diverse customer stakeholders, stakeholder management across customers, Sales, Support and RevOps, and structured project management across several projects at once
* AI Fluency Level 2 in your day-to-day work, with strong discernment: you critically evaluate AI output before sharing it with customers or colleagues

**Nice to have**

* Experience in hospitality technology or an adjacent sector (hotel management, PMS, POS, payments), or familiarity with Mews Hospitality Cloud or a comparable multi-module SaaS platform
* Multilingual, relevant for EMEA portfolio coverage
* Experience contributing to onboarding playbooks, SOPs or team knowledge bases, or using AI tools to draft training materials, automate repetitive documentation or manage project tracking

#### **Pay Transparency at Mews**

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

#### **What's in it for you?**

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

#### **Global benefits**

No matter where you're based, you'll enjoy:

* Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
* Participation in our company share program
* Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)

We give parents a break from the monotony of packing lunch for their kids daily by partnering with popular restaurants students already know and love!

jobs.title: Expert Support Manager (Contract, San Francisco)
jobs.description:
**About Patronus AI**
---------------------

Patronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI. We are on a mission to simulate all of the world's intelligence.

We are the team behind some of the earliest and most influential research in AI evaluation like FinanceBench, Lynx, SimpleSafetyTests, CopyrightCatcher, Humanity's Last Exam, and more. We are formerly AI researchers and engineers from companies like Meta AI, Amazon AGI, and Google. Our customers include foundation model labs and Fortune 500 enterprises like Adobe. We are backed by top-tier investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Notable Capital, Stanford University, Noam Brown, Gokul Rajaram, and more.

**At a glance**
---------------

* Engagement: Independent contractor, on site
* Pay: $50/hr - 150/hr
* Start: Rolling
* Location: San Francisco headquarters, in office 5 days a week
* Team: Expert Operations

**The role**
------------

Our work is produced by practicing domain experts on contract, across many specialist domains. You keep them working.

When an expert cannot submit, cannot access a project, or has not been paid what they expected, that is yours. It covers onboarding paperwork and access, tooling and environment problems, and the whole invoicing and payment path from submitted work to money arriving. Volume is high and it spans every domain we hire into, so you will be the one person who sees the same breakage three times and goes and fixes the cause.

Getting paid correctly and on time is the clearest signal of whether a company is worth working for.

This is a position of trust. You will see what people are owed and you will sit on the path that money takes to reach them. We hire for that first and the rest second. It is also why the role is on site with the team rather than remote.

To support close collaboration, this role is based in our San Francisco headquarters and requires in-office attendance 5 days a week.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run the support queue for the expert bench: onboarding and access, tooling and environment issues, invoicing and payment questions. Resolve what you can, escalate what you cannot, and keep an honest record of both.
* Own the payment path end to end. Know what is owed, what has been submitted, what has been approved and what has actually landed, and chase the gaps before anyone has to ask you.
* Get new experts set up and productive: accounts, access, contracts, payment details, and the first week of small problems that stop people starting.
* Work with the expert managers who own the relationships. They know their people, you know the systems, and an expert should never have to work out which of you to ask.
* Fix causes, not tickets. When the same issue arrives for the third time, write the documentation, change the workflow, or take it to the engineers who own the tool.
* Tell us plainly when a process is the problem.
* Use AI aggressively. Triage, drafting, reconciliation and reporting should all be automated as far as they go, so your hours are spent on the cases that need a person.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

**Required**

* Three or more years in high-volume support, operations or contractor and payroll operations, with people rather than companies as the customer.
* You are comfortable with money. Invoices, rates, approvals, corrections, and the conversation when someone has been underpaid.
* Precision under volume. A payments mistake is not a typo to the person it happens to.
* A track record of being trusted with money or sensitive personal data, and references who will say so without hesitating.
* Clear, calm writing in professional English. Most of this job happens in text, often with someone who is frustrated and has the right to be.
* Ability to work independently, prioritising without being told what is urgent, while working alongside experts in time zones that are not yours.
* Enough technical confidence to debug an access or environment problem a step or two before escalating.
* Comfort working inside internal tooling that is still being built, and reporting the bugs rather than working around them.

**Nice to have**

* Experience supporting a contingent, freelance or marketplace workforce.
* Experience with international contractor payments, including the ways they fail.
* Familiarity with ticketing and support tooling, and with building the macros and documentation behind it rather than only using it.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

You are not the point of contact for an expert's work. Feedback, performance and retention sit with the expert managers, and the quality bar sits with the quality team. Your job is to make sure nobody is blocked by anything other than the work itself.

**How hiring works**
--------------------

* Resume review and a conversation with Talent Operations
* A practical exercise: a real support and payments scenario, handled in writing
* Interview with the team you will sit with
* Reference checks, and a background check before you start
* Onboarding and your first week on the queue

**About YouScience, LLC**

YouScience® is the leading education technology company dedicated to empowering individuals with the data and credentials needed to succeed in school, career, and life.

Its award-winning platform, YouScience Brightpath®, is the only College & Career Readiness solution built for both compliance and impact—powered by scientifically backed aptitude discovery, industry-recognized certifications, and meaningful career connections.

YouScience has served more than 13,400 educational institutions and millions of users nationwide, making it the preferred choice for individuals, parents, educators, and counselors to achieve real outcomes through education and career pathways.

**Job Description**

The Manager of Sales Enablement will be responsible for equipping our revenue teams with the knowledge, content, and tools required to drive growth and improve sales productivity in the education technology sector. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to build, deliver, and continuously optimize onboarding programs, ongoing training, and sales enablement resources. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, combining a strong understanding of B2B/EdTech sales cycles with expertise in instructional design and revenue technology platforms. By bridging product knowledge, market insights, and sales execution, you will play a critical role in helping sales representatives achieve consistent quota performance and accelerate time-to-value for customers. Successful candidates will bring a proactive, data-driven approach to identifying skill gaps, measuring training impact, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and high performance.

This role has the flexibility to be remote, in office (American Fork, Utah), or hybrid.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and manage comprehensive onboarding programs for new sales representatives to accelerate time to productivity.
* Develop and maintain a centralized repository of sales collateral, playbooks, battle cards, and pitch decks in collaboration with Product Marketing.
* Partner with sales leadership to identify skill and knowledge gaps across account executives and territory managers, creating targeted training initiatives.
* Administer and optimize sales technology tools, learning management systems (LMS), and revenue enablement platforms to support day-to-day sales operations.
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate the effectiveness of enablement programs and report metrics to executive stakeholders.
* Facilitate ongoing continuous education, including product releases, competitive positioning, consultative selling methodologies, and industry trends.
* Conduct regular ride-alongs and call reviews (e.g., via Gong) to coach representatives on discovery, handling objections, and closing strategies.
* Collaborate with Product and Marketing teams to translate complex software features into compelling, value-based customer messaging.
* Organize and execute sales enablement events, quarterly sales training workshops, and annual sales kick-off (SKO) programming.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Education, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3-5+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales Training, Product Marketing, or B2B SaaS Sales Excellence roles.
* Proven track record of designing, building, and delivering successful onboarding and continuous training programs for sales teams.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales enablement/LMS technologies (e.g., Docebo, LearnUpon, Gong, Highspot).
* Exceptional presentation, facilitation, and communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences and senior executives.
* Strong understanding of consultative selling methodologies and B2B SaaS buyer journeys.

### **Extra Credit**

* Direct experience working within the Education Technology (EdTech) or K-12 / Higher Education market sectors.
* Prior individual contributor experience in quota-carrying B2B software sales or account management.
* Familiarity with career and technical education (CTE), aptitude assessments, or industry-recognized certifications.
* Formal certifications in sales methodologies (e.g., Challenger, MEDDPICC, Solution Selling) or Instructional Design.

As a Talent Operations Associate, you will be a key contributor to the Talent Operations team, gaining global cross-functional exposure across all areas of Talent Attraction. **The Opportunity**  
The Product Business Operations role is part of the Products team and is responsible for the day-to-day commercial operations of NTS's software business. This person owns the processes that carry a customer from final deal coordination through license fulfillment, ongoing engagement, and renewal.  
Working with sales representatives, Customer Success, Product, Contracts, and Finance, the role keeps customer records accurate, transactions moving, forecasts current, and follow-up actions complete. Sales representatives retain responsibility for outside sales, new-business prospecting, account strategy, and commercial negotiations.

  

**Key Responsibilities** (Principal Duties and Accountabilities \*Essential Functions)

  

Deal Completion and Post Award Coordination

* Support representatives in completing quotes, approvals, order forms, purchase orders, and customer documentation needed to close and process software deals.
* Validate products, quantities, pricing, license terms, support coverage, and delivery requirements against approved orders; resolve discrepancies with Sales, Contracts, and Finance.
* Own the post-award handoff and action tracker through fulfillment, customer receipt, and billing readiness; escalate delays and missing information.

License Fulfillment and Entitlement Management

* Coordinate license issuance, delivery, activation instructions, and receipt confirmation; route technical activation or deployment issues to the appropriate team.
* Maintain accurate records of licensed products, quantities, customer entities, license terms, expiration dates, and maintenance or support entitlements.
* Process approved renewals, expansions, transfers, and license changes; track trial and evaluation expirations with the account representative.

CRM and Forecast Management

* Own CRM data quality across accounts, subaccounts, contacts, opportunities, orders, and renewals; reconcile records with license and transaction information.
* Run a regular forecast review with representatives to validate opportunity values, stages, close dates, procurement status, next steps, and accountable owners.
* Scrub stale opportunities, duplicate records, missing fields, and unsupported close dates; obtain representative updates and flag changes or risks for leadership.

Customer Outreach and Sales Coordination

* Conduct welcome, fulfillment, administrative, and follow-up outreach; maintain current end-user, purchasing, and reseller contacts and track requests to completion.
* Work with representatives to prioritize accounts needing outreach, quote follow-up, procurement assistance, or re-engagement; agree on owners and next actions.
* Coordinate onboarding and customer communications with Customer Success; surface adoption concerns, customer feedback, and expansion opportunities to the appropriate owner.

Renewals and Retention

* Own the renewal calendar and begin outreach early enough to accommodate customer budgeting and procurement timelines; keep representatives informed of upcoming expirations.
* Drive renewal quotes, reminders, approvals, purchase documentation, and fulfillment through completion; coordinate pricing or scope changes with the account representative.
* Identify potential lapses, reductions, or nonrenewals; coordinate recovery actions and record renewal outcomes and reasons for lost or reduced business.

Software Business Operations and Reporting

* Provide fulfillment records for invoicing and work with Finance and representatives to resolve order, billing, and payment-status issues.
* Maintain actionable reports on bookings, recurring revenue, renewals, fulfillment, forecast changes, and outstanding customer actions using definitions and records agreed with Finance.
* Maintain approved product and SKU information, templates, and operating procedures; improve handoffs and routine workflows to reduce errors and manual effort.

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**  
Individual contributor with no direct reports. Manages business processes and coordinates work across teams; operates within established pricing, contracting, and financial approval policies.

* Strong written and spoken English; professional customer communication; ability to handle sensitive customer and commercial information with discretion.
* Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance up to the Secret level.

  

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

  

**Required Skills, Experience & Abilities**

* Minimum 4 years of experience in software business operations, sales operations, revenue operations, renewals, customer operations, or a related role.
* Hands-on CRM experience, including account and opportunity maintenance, data cleanup, reporting, and forecast coordination.
* Experience with software orders, licensing, subscriptions or maintenance renewals, and customer fulfillment processes.
* Strong spreadsheet skills and ability to reconcile customer, order, license, and forecast data accurately.
* Ability to manage competing deadlines, follow up persistently, resolve operational issues, and drive actions to completion across teams.
* Sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to communicate clearly with customers, representatives, and business leaders.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting government or defense customers, contract awards, purchase orders, resellers, and extended procurement cycles.
* Familiarity with both subscription and perpetual software licensing, support renewals, retention reporting, and recurring revenue metrics.
* Experience improving CRM workflows, documenting operating procedures, or automating routine business tasks.

As the sales enablement lead, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping advance the goals of USGBC and GBCI. In this role, you'll take ownership of building the knowledge, skills, tools, and working practices that enable sales and account teams to engage customers, communicate value, and execute the commercial model effectively.

You will lead the development and implementation of a consistent, scalable global sales enablement program that supports commercial teams across all regions, while accounting for regional market dynamics, customer needs, and business priorities.

You'll design and manage onboarding, learning programs, sales playbooks, practical training, and ongoing reinforcement in partnership with regional directors, market leads, product, marketing, client solutions, and sales operations. You'll also provide partner enablement where assigned.

You'll report to the director of sales operations and work closely with regional directors, market leads, account management, client solutions, product, marketing, and technology teams to support sales success across all global regions and markets.

As a global individual contributor and program lead, you will establish consistent enablement standards, share best practices across regions, and ensure that sales teams have the resources and capabilities needed to effectively represent USGBC and GBCI products and services worldwide.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global sales enablement strategy and readiness:** assess role-based capability needs using manager input, field observations, customer and partner feedback, and performance data. Develop and execute a global sales enablement plan that aligns with organizational priorities, addresses regional capability gaps, and establishes consistent sales readiness standards across all markets.
* **Sales onboarding and learning programs:** design, implement, and maintain practical onboarding and ongoing learning programs for market leads, customer account managers, channel partner account managers, and assigned partners. Cover product portfolio knowledge, consultative selling, discovery, value communication, qualification, account planning, opportunity management, and escalation procedures. Ensure learning programs are scalable, accessible, and adaptable to global teams operating across different regions and time zones.
* **Sales playbooks, tools, and content management:** translate approved product knowledge, value propositions, and commercial processes into practical learning modules, sales playbooks, discovery guides, objection-handling resources, and job aids. Establish content ownership, version control, review cycles, and retirement procedures to maintain accurate and current materials. Create a centralized, consistent approach to sales enablement resources that supports global accessibility and knowledge sharing.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Job Title:** Customer Support Specialist

**Location:** Remote | USA
  
**Reports to:** Customer Support Team Lead

**Employment Type:** Full-time

This is an existing vacancy

**About the Role:**

In this role, you will manage and support a portfolio of dealer accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from the company’s products and services. You will proactively monitor account performance, identify issues, and coordinate with cross-functional teams to deliver timely and effective solutions that drive customer satisfaction and retention.

You will also play a key role in program growth by increasing dealer engagement, enrollments, and overall participation. Success in this position requires strong organizational skills, with the ability to track and manage accounts, products, and issue resolution using tools such as Excel and Salesforce CRM.

You will drive dealer satisfaction, retention, and program growth by ensuring clients realize value from SmartDigital products. Through proactive account management, issue resolution, and strong communication, you will improve performance, increase engagement, and strengthen long-term customer.

The ideal Customer Support Agent will be responsible for supporting program operations, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction through timely issue resolution and effective communication.

**In this role, you will:**

* Ensure all enrollments, activations, cancellations, buy/sell activities, and program changes are accurately captured and processed.
* Create, manage, and update Salesforce cases, ensuring all required information is documented for accurate reporting and resolution.
* Monitor customer support tickets and escalations, providing timely follow-up and resolution while adhering to established service level expectations.
* Maintain accurate customer, dealer, and program data to support clean reporting and operational efficiency.
* Support data validation efforts by reviewing enrollments, activations, cancellations, and customer records for accuracy and completeness.
* Assist with troubleshooting program connections and integrations, escalating issues when necessary.
* Participate in assigned internal and external meetings, providing updates on open issues, enrollments, cancellations, and program performance.
* Share critical information, updates, and process changes with team members to ensure alignment and consistency.
* Collaborate with Partner Managers, Dealers, Vendors, Field Teams, and internal departments to support customer needs and program objectives.
* Assist with data audits and reporting activities to ensure accurate program tracking and measurement.
* Monitor inboxes, queues, and case assignments to ensure timely action on customer requests.
* Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and follow-up activities.
* Follow established processes and procedures while identifying opportunities for process improvements and increased efficiency.
Support customer onboarding activities, including activation tracking and coordination with applicable stakeholders.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent
* Proven experience in customer support and success
* Background in the automotive digital space preferred
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM preferred
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and Microsoft Office tools
Ability to work independently in a full-time, remote, work-from-home environment with a flexible schedule  

**Compensation and Benefits**

This position has a starting salary range of $20.00-$21.00 per hour. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

  
  
  

**Why Join JD Power**

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

* **We power our customers’ success.** Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

* **We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data.** We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

* **We make things easy.** We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

* **We get it done.** We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

* **We start with trust and prove it every day.** Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.

  

**Equal Opportunity & Accommodations**

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact careers@jdpower.com for accommodation request.

Verint is looking for a Sales Operations Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team. Sales Performance Analytics

CRM & Data Management

**Job Description**

The Professional Development (PD) Program Coordinator administers and coordinates the day-to-day operation of El Camino

Health’s professional development and clinical education programs, such as the HealthStream learning management system

(LMS), Relationship-Based Care (RBC), Crisis Prevention Instruction (CPI), the ECH Clinical Ladder program, and more.

Reporting to the Director of Clinical Education, this role serves as the central point of coordination and governance for these

programs by ensuring learning assignments, competencies, records, and program logistics are accurate, timely, compliant,

and consistently delivered across clinical staff.

Working with a high degree of independence, the PD Program Coordinator handles a wide range of program administration

tasks, resolves atypical or infrequently occurring issues using established precedents and practices, and applies discretion to

improve workflows and prevent avoidable rework. The role safeguards the integrity of regulatory-required training and

competency records, supports organizational readiness for Joint Commission surveys and Magnet Program requirements, and

serves as a resource to those who rely on these programs.

In addition to program coordination, the role provides direct administrative support to the operational leaders of these

programs, including the Director of Clinical Education, the Director of the Magnet Program, and the Director of Clinical

Business Operations by coordinating meetings, materials, reporting, and follow-up that keep initiatives organized and on

track.

**Job Description**

* Administers the HealthStream LMS: builds, assigns, schedules, and maintains courses, curricula, competencies, and

regulatory modules; manages user accounts, groups, and permissions; troubleshoots access and completion issues; and

maintains accurate learning and competency records across clinical.

* Serves as the central coordinator for assigned professional development programs, including Relationship-Based Care,

Crisis Prevention Instruction, Clinical Ladder, and others by managing enrollment, scheduling, materials, tracking, and

logistics so each program is delivered consistently and on schedule.

* Establishes and maintains centralized governance and quality controls over learning assignments to prevent duplicate,

outdated, or missed module assignments and to reduce avoidable retraining and rework.

* Monitors mandatory education and competency due dates; proactively identify at-risk assignments and coordinates with

Nursing Professional Development Specialists (NPDS) and Clinical Managers to maintain survey readiness.

* Generates, maintains, and distributes completion, compliance, and competency reports; responds accurately and

promptly to requests from leadership, regulatory bodies, and accrediting agencies (e.g., Joint Commission, CDPH, CMS,

Magnet).

standards that increase efficiency and enhance the participant and stakeholder experience.

* Resolves atypical or non-routine program, scheduling, LMS, and data issues using established precedents and practices;

escalates broader risks as appropriate.

* Maintains program documentation, job aids, and reference materials; guides and supports NPDS, managers, and staff in

navigating HealthStream and program requirements.

* Coordinates with vendors and system partners (e.g., HealthStream) on configuration, updates, and issue resolution.
* Provides direct administrative support to the operational leaders of professional development programs—including the

Director of Clinical Education, the Director of the Magnet Program, and the Director of Clinical Business Operations.

* Prepares and formats agendas, meeting notes, presentations, and executive summaries for program leaders; tracks

action items and deadlines to keep initiatives moving.

* Serves as a formal or informal resource to less-experienced colleagues and provides cross-coverage for key program

administration functions during peak needs or absences.

**Qualifications**

* Associate’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Education, Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or an

new_jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Our Customer Experience team owns the full post-sales lifecycle for one of Rippling’s largest business units, from onboarding and implementation to escalations and renewals—we’re united by a passion for customers and continuous improvement, and we’re committed to personal and professional growth.

In this role, you're expected to be a builder: you’ll design and run the post-sales operating model for the business unit from the ground up. Our model runs on a lean, task-based system where every motion is defined, measured, and repeatable. You’ll define what success looks like, set the KPIs, map and build the workflows, write the playbooks, and keep refining the machine as the business grows.

You will also bridge data and day-to-day execution: building multi-factor health scores, engineering automated risk interventions, refining lifecycle touch points across the whole Product Experience to maximize retention outcomes.

Last, you’ll be the technical architect of the systems behind it and be the main business partner to CX leadership. You’ll find the truth in the data, turn it into action, and own the outcome.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Build the post-sales operating model for the business unit: define success at each lifecycle stage, set the KPIs, and design how work flows across onboarding, implementation, customer success, escalations, and renewals.
* Own the architecture, data integrity, and configuration of our CX systems. Partner cross-functionally on integrations across CRM, billing, support, and product analytics.
* Analyze intervention outcomes to understand why accounts churn or save, and use what you learn to refine playbooks and train the team on save and de-escalation strategies.
* Establish automated early warning systems that detect leading indicators of churn well before renewal windows open.
* Develop proactive intervention playbooks mapped to specific risk triggers (e.g., missed payments, steep drops in platform activity, repeated support escalations).
* Own the customer sentiment program (NPS, CSAT): build and administer lifecycle-triggered surveys, analyze trends across customer segments, and run a closed-loop detractor playbook.
* Prepare and run weekly business reviews, and deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting on gross and net retention, save rates, health score trends, and operational capacity.
* Manage and mentor a team of Retention Specialists through regular 1:1s, performance coaching, and workflow reviews. Set the SOPs, turnaround targets, and escalation protocols they work from.
* Partner with Product, Sales, and Support to surface upstream product frictions, onboarding bottlenecks, or misaligned customer expectations that contribute to churn.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **A builder.** You want to build the right system or workflow rather than inherit it; you’re comfortable in ambiguity, and you’ve done that before.
* **An owner.** When you see a problem, you act with urgency and you proactively own it until it’s solved; you are effective as a cross-functional operator.
* **A truth seeker.** You go to the data and to the frontline, you challenge assumptions (including your own), and make decisions based on what’s actually happening.
* **Thorough.** You sweat the details in workflows, data, and documentation, because a system is only as good as its details. You keep making the process better.

**What you will have**
----------------------

* 3–10+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, RevOps, or CX Management within a B2B SaaS environment.
* 1+ years of direct people management or lead experience guiding retention, support, or customer success specialists.
* Experience building operations from the ground up in a high-growth environment.
* Track record of designing retention programs, renewal/save programs, and/or building automated risk-alert frameworks tied directly to measurable retention gains.
* Technical comfort owning and building systems; You're comfortable with SFDC, Jira, and/or CSP platforms (e.g. Vitally, Gainsight or ChurnZero), navigating API integrations, bi-directional syncing, and event-based tracking schemas.
* Strong data literacy; proficient in mapping SaaS metrics (NRR, GRR, Churn, LTV, Adoption velocity) and synthesizing raw analytics into operational priorities.
* Emerging AI Tooling Experience: you are comfortable integrating LLMs (e.g., Claude, OpenAI APIs) into CX tech stacks for automated ticket summarization, health score analysis, or retention playbook drafting.

**Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?**

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

**Staff Program Manager**
=========================

The Staff Program Manager leads large, strategic programs spanning multiple teams, domains, and business initiatives. This role translates strategy into scalable delivery plans, navigates ambiguity, and delivers measurable business outcomes. Staff Program Managers are recognized leaders who bring clarity to complex situations, elevate execution maturity, influence cross-functional decisions, and scale effective practices across teams and programs. They combine business acumen, technical fluency, and sound judgment to improve organizational effectiveness and accelerate value delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the full lifecycle of large, complex programs with significant cross-functional and organizational impact.
* Define program vision, success metrics, and long-range delivery plans aligned to strategic objectives.
* Navigate ambiguity by anticipating risks, resolving systemic issues, and aligning teams and stakeholders.
* Use technical fluency to assess architectural risks, validate timelines, identify acceleration opportunities, and guide delivery tradeoffs.
* Synthesize business, delivery, and KPI data to guide priorities, resource decisions, tradeoffs, and program pivots.
* Improve delivery by simplifying processes, reducing complexity, and scaling proven models across teams and domains.
* Advise senior leaders with clear, data-backed communication on risks, decisions, and recommendations.
* Mentor PMs across levels while strengthening organizational delivery capability and execution discipline.

**Scope & Influence**

* Operates independently across multiple teams, domains, or strategic initiatives.
* Influences senior leaders and cross-functional decision-making across organizational boundaries.
* Improves delivery models, operating mechanisms, and cross-functional operating rhythms.
* Accountable for sustained business impact, value realization, and execution maturity across programs.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience leading large, high-impact programs across multiple teams, domains, or business functions.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Proven ability to define a program vision and success measures that connect business strategy and scalable delivery.
* Track record of leading through high ambiguity, addressing risks, resolving complex issues, and maintaining stakeholder alignment.
* Technical fluency to partner with engineering leaders, assess architectural risks, validate delivery plans, and accelerate execution without directing solutions.
* Ability to synthesize business outcomes and KPI data to guide prioritization, tradeoffs, and investment decisions.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and cross-functional leaders to align decisions.
* Success scaling delivery processes, frameworks, tools, or operating mechanisms across teams or domains to improve predictability and execution.
* Experience mentoring program managers and contributing to delivery standards and best practices.
* Proven ability to lead across cultures and regions, navigate varied working and communication styles, and align globally distributed teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Leading transformations that introduce new operating models, governance, or enterprise capabilities.
* Influencing portfolio strategy, investment decisions, and cross-domain prioritization through data-driven insights.
* Coaching program managers on delivery excellence, systems thinking, and stakeholder management.
* Establishing repeatable frameworks, playbooks, or organizational mechanisms that improve execution quality and business outcomes at scale.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.
  
  
In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package.

$188,600—$283,000 USD

new_jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 175785
  
  
**Job Category:** Project / Program Management
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Technology & Security
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland; San Ramon; Vacaville
  
  
Department Overview
  
  
Corporate Security leads the effort to deliver secure and reliable technology and operational outcomes across the organization. Collaborating closely with Cyber Security, Corporate Security is dedicated to protecting California’s critical infrastructure by connecting physical, operational, and cyber defense to reduce risk and enhance resilience. The department consists of forward-thinking security operators, builders, and creators who design and manage protective operations that keep the organization at the forefront of modern security, combining disciplined execution with continuous improvement, innovation, and strong partnerships throughout the business. Position Summary
  
  
Corporate Security is seeking a self-starting, customer-focused Senior Program Manager to lead the performance and continuous improvement of PG&E’s Badge and Physical Access ID Program. This role is ideal for a highly organized strategic problem solver who can translate operational needs into clear program plans, reliable service delivery, measurable outcomes, and consistent coworker experience.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as the primary subject matter expert for badge and identification services; oversee daily operations, ordering, and contracted specialist performance; and connect badge and physical access processes across New Employee Orientation, Safety Summits, visitor management, coworker education, training, communications, and culture practices. The role works independently on most issues, directs the overall program plan and goals, owns program deliverables, and communicates findings and recommendations to multiple levels of management.
  
  
The role is hybrid working from your remote office and in-person at various PG&E locations throughout the service territory, based on business needs. Job Responsibilities
  
Provide direction for the overall Badge and Physical Access ID Program plan, goals, implementation activities, and performance expectations, taking a fresh perspective on moderate to complex operational problems and existing solutions. Own most or all program deliverables and oversee day-to-day performance of badge and identification services, including ordering, inventory coordination, fulfillment, issue resolution, service quality, and continuous improvement. Serve as the primary subject matter expert for badge and identification processes, requirements, and customer guidance, maintaining strong working relationships with Corporate Security partners, business stakeholders, vendors, and customers. Develop, measure, and report program metrics, service levels, trends, risks, and business insights; prepare recurring and ad hoc reports and communicate findings and recommendations to various levels of management. Manage relationships with contracted specialists and vendors, provide direction on work and deliverables, monitor performance and compliance, and address service gaps through documented corrective actions and process improvements. Identify and maintain oversight of physical access process intersections, including New Employee Orientation, Safety Summits, visitor management, coworker education, training, communications, and culture practices. Partners across the organization to develop and implement policies, procedures, controls, communications, and engagement strategies that improve awareness, adoption, and the customer experience for badge and physical access services. Monitor program spending, analyze actual and projected costs, identify variances and waste, escalate issues or emerging risks, and recommend solutions that improve efficiency, strengthen financial stewardship, and support reliable program delivery. Lead the marketing and communication of the Badge and Physical Access ID Program, producing clear customer-facing materials, training resources, and targeted outreach for appropriate audiences. Assess program needs and recommend new partners, technologies, tools, or delivery channels that strengthen service performance, compliance, resilience, and operational efficiency. Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum :**  
Bachelor degree or equivalent experience. 6 years of related experience or equivalent. Desired:
  
Undergraduate degree in business administration, security management, criminal justice, or a related field. Experience managing or supporting an enterprise badging, identity credentialing, or physical access program. Experience in corporate security, physical security, access control, or a related security discipline. Advanced knowledge of program management and demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects with demanding time constraints. Experience developing performance metrics, operational reports, dashboards, service-level measures, and recommendations for management. Experience providing direction to contractors or vendors and monitoring performance against defined standards and deliverables. Strong customer focus, organizational skills, strategic problem-solving ability, and written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a regulated environment and assess and recommend practical solutions based on business drivers and customer needs.
  
  
Compensation
  
  
PG&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be around the minimum and the midpoint of the range. The final decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to the factors above.
