new_jobs.title: Process Commissioning Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla is looking for a Process System Technical Project Manager experienced in design, scoping, scheduling, execution, and turnover of commissioning projects for a solar cell semi-conductor fabrication facility. This role specializes in process plant design review, commissioning, optimization, process related calculations, simulation, troubleshooting, safety reviews, and on-site support. Utilities include bulk fluid process systems, cryogenic, chemical, hydrogen, steam, and other systems associated with semi-conductor fabrication. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical operations background with plant startup, isolation, management of change, commissioning, process design, and optimization. Design experience producing deliverable such as process calculations, simulations, P&IDs, equipment sizing, sequences of operation, and operational procedures is required. The candidate will coordinate commissioning, transition to operations, and improvements through product qualification. Working experience with OSHA PSM regulated systems and HAZOPs is required. With respect to project management, you will be responsible for owning commissioning project scheduling, personnel management, budget, design reviews, risk management, procurement coordination, planning work, managing work in the field, and troubleshooting system performance issues. It requires technical expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to effectively support multiple teams. This role has a travel expectancy of up to 25%.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own all Cx related phases of process system design, startup, commissioning, operations optimization
* Perform design reviews, safety reviews, develop of procedures, checklists, field reports, schedule, budget, and other technical documents to execute the commissioning scope
* During startup and operations drive safe plant operations, optimization, shutdowns, improvements, management of change, and supporting design deliverables
* Generate procedures and support training of operators across a variety of process types including safe isolation, startup, operation, and shutdown
* Attend Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT). Coordinate and perform Site Acceptance and Integrated System Tests (SAT/IST)
* Maintain communications regarding schedule, budget, and progress updates with key stakeholders

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, or equivalent experience
* Minimum of 10 years of operations intensive experience in the commissioning of process systems and at least 5 years of project management experience
* Deep technical expertise in process design and optimization
* Exceptional dedication to safety and experience managing control of process systems
* Ability to lead a team to meet project milestones. Procure and manage 3rd party contractors
* Technical expertise with rotating and static equipment, compressed air, process fluids, cryogenics, wet mechanical, and OSHA PSM regulated systems
* Strong background in all aspects of scope management including, scheduling, budgeting, and documentation. Experience bidding, onboarding, and managing contractors

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)

  

#### **Expected Compensation**

$140,000 - $270,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager II - Devices Beta, Amazon Devices Beta
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Amazon Devices Beta (ADB) Team is your hall pass to play at work!! We are responsible for the “real world validation” for Kindle eReaders, Fire Tablets, FireTV products, and Emerging products…think, Amazon Smart Oven and Amazon Basics Microwave. How do we do this? By playing with these products every day! We work with product and engineering teams to prepare new product launches, system software and app updates, and marketplace expansions. Our goal is to gather feedback and expose issues and bugs prior to the product launching, so we delight our customers with products beyond their expectations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The ADB Team needs an experienced Program Manager to help us build and execute programs to validate the customer experience during the product development cycle. You will work with end users and a wide variety of internal teams to develop the strategy and execute the program to confirm from a customer perspective we are ready to launch. You will be a “hands on” contributor to support and troubleshoot issues, resolve problems, and keep the feedback flowing. Along the way, you’ll identify opportunities for improvements and put processes and tools in place to help us scale. You will track, communicate status, and independently drive issues to resolution. Cross-team coordination, program management, and an ability to learn and understand new technologies are essential.  
  
A day in the life  
Our programs are global and composed of Amazon employees across the company. We put pre-released devices and/or software in the hands of beta testers who represent our target customer profile ("people all about smart home automation", "people who love to read", or "people who are native speakers of French"). Working with our product team counterparts, we ask testers for “no holds barred” feedback to tell us what works and what needs to be fixed. Our bar is always being raised and we strive to achieve an Amazon 4-Star or better product every time!  
  
About the team  
The Amazon Devices Beta Team is responsible pre-launch customer feedback for our products. The team is composed of program managers who love technology and devices. Together with product owners, we plan and execute beta programs focused on gathering early customer feedback to help Amazon ship devices and software that delight customers. Our objective is to leverage the voice of the customer to validate and improve the experience and make an informed decision regarding launch readiness.

------------------------

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

**Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure**

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

You will run the day-to-day operating rhythm of Crux's technology organization and keep the programs that cut across it on track. Reporting to our CTPO, you will build and maintain the integrated plan for how Compute, Networking, Security, AI Ops, and ServerOps deliver our first production TPU clusters, and you will be the person who knows what is on track, what is at risk, and who needs to make a decision to fix it. You will run the working-level program cadence with Google, connect engineering milestones to the capacity plan of record and to customer commitments, and keep the CTPO's priorities moving while the organization is still being built. This is a builder's seat: you build the plans, the dashboards, and the tools yourself.

**In this role, you will:**

* Build and maintain the integrated technology plan for the first builds: milestones, dependencies, and readiness gates across Compute, Networking, Security, AI Ops, and ServerOps, from cluster design through customer handoff.
* Run the technical program cadence with Google on TPU hardware, software, and services delivery, and track action items and commitments on both sides.
* Work with Capacity Delivery, Data Center Engineering, and the Development program managers where site delivery hands off to cluster bring-up, so that every handoff from rack-ready to customer-ready is tracked against the committed date.
* Run the CTPO operating rhythm: weekly reviews, quarterly planning inputs, and goal tracking. Prepare the materials for executive and board updates.
* Surface risks early and bring them to the right owner with the decision needed, the options, and a date, rather than reporting status after the fact.
* Track the CTPO hiring plan and headcount with Recruiting and Finance, and help each new team get set up as its leader arrives.
* Build the program tooling yourself: plans, dashboards, and AI-enabled workflows that keep status current without status meetings.

**SIGNALS OF SUCCESS**

**After 60 days in this role:**

* Learned the capacity plan of record, the Google partnership model, and our first customer commitments, and published the first version of the integrated technology plan for the first build.
* Stood up the CTPO weekly review and the working cadence with Google.
* Adapted to a fast-paced environment, triaging appropriately and continuously improving our function.

**After 6 months:**

* Kept the integrated plan current through the first production TPU cluster delivery, with readiness gates that caught issues before they became delays.
* Become the place leadership goes first for an accurate read on technology delivery status, risks, and open decisions.
* Demonstrated an AI-forward and automated approach to this role: you have built, in a hands-on way, AI-enabled tools for planning, tracking, or reporting that the team uses every day.

**After 1 year:**

* Turned the lessons from the first build into a repeatable delivery playbook for the next sites.
* Kept execution steady as the CTPO organization grew from its first leaders to a full team.
* Become a trusted partner to the CTPO and engineering leads on keeping priorities and tradeoffs visible.

**EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH**

**Experiences**

* 7+ years in technical program management, including 3+ years on cross-functional programs for large-scale infrastructure at a hyperscaler, neocloud, or data center operator.
* Delivered programs that spanned hardware, network, and software, such as new cluster or region launches, new hardware introductions, or data center bring-ups, against hard dates.
* Experience working with senior leaders and external partners, including running workstreams in a joint program with a strategic technology partner.

**Attributes**

* You are outcome driven and hands-on. You build your own plans, dashboards, and tools, and you use AI and automation by default. This is a builder's seat, not a supervisory one.
* You are technical enough to be useful. You can follow an engineering tradeoff on fabric design or cluster bring-up and know which question to ask.
* You have a high tolerance for ambiguity. You absorb ambiguity and navigate complexity rather than passing it along.

**Mindset**

* You are skeptical by default. "On track" is a hypothesis until the dependency owner shows you the evidence.
* You deliver through discipline, not heroics. You build the process that makes the next launch boring.
* You are AI-agentic first. Fluent with AI agents, or committed to becoming so quickly, you embed them as first principles in how you and your team work, defaulting to agentic workflows before adding headcount or process.

* Technical program management at a hyperscaler (Google, Meta, Microsoft, AWS) or a neocloud (CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe).

* Familiarity with data center power, cooling, and capacity planning.
* An engineering degree, or a PMP or similar program management certification.

Petit Pot is a growing food manufacturing company based in Emeryville, CA. We produce high-quality French-inspired desserts and are proud to be a Certified B Corporation, balancing purpose and profit while considering the impact of our decisions on our employees, customers, community, and the environment.

POSITION SUMMARY

The QA Technician is responsible for ensuring that all production paperwork is completed, collected, organized, reviewed, and filed to the satisfaction of all pertinent regulatory agencies and customers. Ensure the site is always audit-ready by maintaining GMP, Organic, SQF, and any other certifications. Ensure the quality of all incoming ingredients, batches, and finished products. Perform required quality testing of products and records accurate product specifications in a timely manner. The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of food safety protocols, quality control processes, and regulatory compliance in the food manufacturing industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Maintain a solid and up-to-date understanding of all regulatory issues pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.

- Maintain a solid and up-to-date understanding of all customer requirements and preferences pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.

- Collect all production paperwork, ensuring that any missing paperwork is located.

- Provide aggressive reporting and retraining for all incomplete, incorrect, or non-compliant paperwork.

- Organize paperwork per established filing system.

- Review paperwork, ensuring that all process CCP’s, quality specifications, and customer requirements have been met. Any product affected by deviations or missing records must be reported to QA Manager and placed on QA hold.

- Ensure all equipment is set up, calibrated, and functioning properly throughout your shift.

- Keep all equipment that is used clean, in your area always, and prepared for the next run.

- Place batches of finished products on hold as required.

- Copy batch cards as required for kitchen operators.

- GED or High School Diploma

- Handcarts and pallet jacks.

- PCQI Certified (Plus, not required)

- HACCP Certified (Plus, not required)

- Knowledge of food safety regulations, quality standards, and production best practices.

- Experience with lean manufacturing, process improvement, or waste reduction is a plus.

- Experience in dessert, dairy, pudding, or refrigerated food production is a plus.

**About Rivet**  
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.  
  
We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.  
  
At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.  
  
**Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).**

**Summary**

Rivet Industries builds rugged hardware and software for defense and industrial frontline workers. We are looking for an experienced Quality Manager to build and lead quality across the company, from the first prototype through shipped product in the field.

This is the first dedicated quality leadership role at Rivet. You will own the quality system end to end, grow a small team, and set the standard our contract manufacturers, suppliers and internal teams build to. Our products are made with contract manufacturers overseas today, and we are standing up US manufacturing alongside them, so you will build a quality program that works across both.

You will lead every quality function in the org.

* Supplier quality: contract manufacturer and component supplier quality, including audits, qualification, incoming inspection, SCARs and supplier scorecards
* In-house quality engineering: inspection plans, process controls, first article inspection and line quality for our US builds
* Company quality system: the QMS itself, including ISO 9001 certification (with a path toward AS9100), document control, internal audits, CAPA and management review
* Software quality: release quality standards and test gates for the software that ships on and with our hardware, in partnership with Software
* Compliance: oversight of trade compliance, regulatory and product certifications, environmental compliance and safety

**Responsibilities**

* Define and run Rivet's quality strategy, policies and metrics, and report quality performance to Operations and executive leadership
* Build, implement and maintain a QMS that achieves ISO 9001 certification and scales toward AS9100 and defense customer requirements
* Lead supplier and contract manufacturer quality: qualification audits, quality agreements, process audits, SCARs and corrective action through closure
* Set up quality for US in-house manufacturing, including inspection, first article inspection, process controls and nonconforming material review
* Own quality gates across NPI: DFM/DFT input, PFMEA and control plans, build readiness reviews and production release criteria
* Run a closed-loop CAPA process and lead 8D investigations on significant escapes
* Partner with Software to set release quality standards and test gates for shipped software
* Oversee compliance across trade (export controls such as ITAR/EAR), product regulatory certifications, environmental (RoHS, REACH) and safety, and support customer and government audits
* Work with Engineering, Program Management, Supply Chain and Manufacturing to make quality a design and build requirement, not an end-of-line check
* Hire, develop and lead a team of quality, reliability and compliance engineers as the company grows

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field
* 10+ years in quality engineering or quality management for electronic or electromechanical hardware
* 5+ years leading quality teams or a quality function
* Hands-on experience managing contract manufacturers and suppliers, including overseas (Asia) manufacturing
* Experience building or running an ISO 9001 QMS and leading a company through certification or surveillance audits
* Deep working knowledge of quality tools: FMEA, control plans, SPC, MSA, first article inspection, 8D and root cause analysis
* Experience taking products from NPI through volume production
* Ability to work across engineering, operations and leadership, and to set direction without a large existing team
* Willingness to travel to contract manufacturers and suppliers (domestic and international)
* Ability to meet U.S. export control (ITAR) requirements

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in defense, aerospace or other regulated hardware (AS9100, MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461, DFARS flow-downs)
* Startup or early-stage experience building a quality function from the ground up
* Experience standing up a new US factory or production line
* Familiarity with IPC-A-610 / J-STD-001 workmanship standards
* Experience with export, environmental and product certification programs
* Experience with a PLM/QMS system (for example Arena)
* ASQ certification (CQE, CQM/OE or CRE) or Six Sigma Black Belt

**About CoreSite:**

**Commissioning Program Manager - Data Center:**

As a member of the company's Engineering team, the Commissioning Program Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of commissioning activities across data center projects, including greenfield builds, expansions, and system upgrades. This role ensures that all mechanical, electrical, and control systems are designed, installed, tested, and validated to meet performance, quality, and operational readiness requirements. You will collaborate closely with design teams, contractors, commissioning authorities, operations, and cross‑functional stakeholders to oversee commissioning plans, testing protocols, documentation, and issue resolution. This role requires technical leadership, strong project management capability, and deep fluency in mission‑critical systems and commissioning standards.

* As the owner's representative, oversee Level 1-5 commissioning reviews and execution, ensuring testing validates performance against specifications.

**Documentation & Reporting:**

* Develop and maintain comprehensive system for tracking and storing commissioning documentation, including test results, reports, and as‑built records.
* Represent the owner in project commissioning meetings, communicate commissioning progress to internal stakeholders, and maintain Engineering Team alignment and engagement throughout the commissioning lifecycle.
* Manage commissioning scope definition and CxA procurement while ensuring effective onboarding, documentation management, and reporting for third-party commissioning teams.
* Promote innovation and continuous improvement in commissioning processes and tools.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Flexibility to travel up to 40%, with the potential for increased travel or in-office presence as business needs evolve.
* Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, control systems, and building automation systems (BMS/EPMS).

* Excellent communication, leadership, and cross-team coordination skills.
* Strong project management capabilities including planning, scheduling, and reporting.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Construction Management, Building Services, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in data center commissioning, QA/QC, construction management, or mission critical environments

* Experience working with third party CxAs and data center development programs.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Title**: BioQUEST Curriculum Consortium, Program Coordinator

**Location**: Remote, US-based

**Hours**: Part-time, averaging 10–15 hours per week

**Reports to**: Executive Director

**Compensation**: Hourly rate commensurate with experience, minimum $25 per hour

**Start Date**: December 1, 2026

Join a national community of life science educators in a flexible, part-time role you can do from anywhere in the US. This **remote position** averages 10–15 hours per week and is ideal for someone who enjoys keeping programs organized, working with partners and volunteers, and sharing the story of innovation in STEM education.

**About Us**

BioQUEST Curriculum Consortium is a transformative, collaborative community empowering life science educators to drive innovation in STEM education. For 40 years, BioQUEST has led innovation in biology education, with a continuing emphasis on effective uses of inquiry, technology, professional development, and curriculum development.

BioQUEST is a remote-first, independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit based in Rockingham County, NH, engaging a wide array of volunteer and staff leaders across the country.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and reliable **Program Coordinator** to keep BioQUEST’s professional development programs running smoothly and make sure our community hears about them. Working with staff, volunteers, and partners, you’ll coordinate the online BIOME summer workshop and semester-long faculty opportunities, and help shape the newsletters, social media, and campaigns that reach our members.

Our opportunities are led by partner and volunteer facilitators, and you’ll work with these volunteers to ensure quality. The role also works closely with representatives from professional scientific societies, externally funded education projects, and faculty special interest groups.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Professional Development Programs**

* *BIOME Summer Workshop*: Coordinate BioQUEST’s virtual BIOME summer workshop, held one week in July.
* *Year-Round Opportunities*: Coordinate BioQUEST’s other professional development opportunities.
* *Volunteer Coordination*: Support the partner and volunteer facilitators who lead our opportunities.

**Communications & Outreach**

* Organize content creation for newsletters, coordinating with partners and team members to keep messaging consistent and high quality.
* Share news, events, and resources with BioQUEST communities through social media, press releases, announcements, and blog posts.
* Highlight community successes and recognize contributors.
* Design graphics for marketing materials and update presentations for external audiences.

**Qualifications**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
* Self-motivated, proactive, reliable, flexible, and adaptable.
* Ability to work and communicate in a team environment.
* Ability to multitask, act independently, and prioritize.

Helpful but not required:

* Bachelor’s degree in STEM, marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, and social media.
* Experience in project coordination and with project management tools and methodologies.
* Experience creating content or running communications campaigns; a confident storyteller and writer.
* Familiarity with graphic design and basic HTML editing.

We know there are great candidates who won’t check all these boxes, and you might bring important skills we haven’t considered. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself.

This role is only available to candidates legally authorized to work in the United States; visa sponsorship is not provided at this time.

**Hours & Work Environment**

This **remote, part-time position** averages **10–15 hours per week** on a flexible schedule, with potential for additional hours on special projects. Though fully remote, meetings are scheduled during the workday based in Eastern Time. Expect more intensive time leading up to and during the BIOME summer workshop, held one week in July. The role includes regular BioQUEST meetings on Zoom and virtual meetings with partners as needed.

BioQUEST is a distributed organization with collaborators throughout the United States. The work includes both synchronous and asynchronous components and requires a modern computer and a stable internet connection. The job involves frequent desk work and sitting for extended periods, long periods of screen time, and regular virtual meetings.

**What Success Looks Like**

**Success in this role means BioQUEST’s professional development programs run smoothly and our community hears about them.** The BIOME summer workshop and year-round opportunities are well organized, volunteer facilitators are supported, programs stay high quality, and newsletters, social media, and announcements go out consistently and on time.

**Compensation**

Hourly rate commensurate with experience, minimum $25 per hour.

Screening of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled. If you need accommodation during the application process, contact Sarah Prescott at .

new_jobs.description:
Heartbeat Health is the leading virtual-first cardiovascular care company in the country, providing patients with convenient, high-quality heart care through a combination of telemedicine, diagnostics, and virtual care programs. By leveraging real-time data and AI-powered insights, Heartbeat Health empowers providers and patients with personalized treatment plans, reducing hospitalizations and improving long-term heart health outcomes. Heartbeat Health is redefining how cardiovascular care is delivered in the digital age, led by our medical group of cardiologists, advanced practitioners, nurses, and care coordinators.

  

### **About the Job:**

We are seeking a Patient Experience Coordinator to join our virtual clinic team. This is a full-time, remote position requiring availability to work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Central Time (CST/CDT).

This entry-level opportunity is ideal for individuals who are passionate about delivering exceptional patient experiences and eager to grow their careers in the healthcare technology industry. As a Patient Experience Coordinator, you will serve as a key point of contact for patients, helping them navigate their cardiovascular care journey while ensuring a seamless and supportive experience.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Patient Outreach & Engagement:** Proactively connect with patients via phone, text, and email to coordinate virtual appointments, schedule diagnostic testing (such as stress tests and echocardiograms), and support ongoing patient engagement.
* **Patient Support & Experience:** Deliver a high-quality, concierge-level experience by assisting patients with technical questions, navigating virtual care platforms, and ensuring they feel informed and supported throughout their care journey.
* **Operational Support:** Maintain accurate patient information, document interactions, identify opportunities for process improvement, and support efficient daily clinic operations.
* **Collaboration & Growth:** Work closely with clinical and operational teams to improve patient workflows, support new healthcare programs, and contribute to the continued growth of our virtual care services.

### **About You:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Social Work, Communications, Education, Sociology, Psychology, Health Sciences, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:** At least 6 months of professional work or internship experience, preferably in a customer-facing or service-oriented environment.
* **Customer Service Focus:** Experience in high-touch, customer-facing roles such as hospitality, retail, food service, or call centers, with the ability to navigate fast-paced environments while maintaining professionalism and empathy.
* **People-Oriented:** Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for helping others, building relationships, and creating positive experiences.
* **Mission-Driven:** Genuine enthusiasm for supporting patients and making a meaningful impact on their healthcare experience and outcomes.
* **Tech-Savvy & Adaptable:** Comfortable navigating technology, maintaining accurate records, and learning new systems and healthcare platforms in a fast-paced, virtual environment.
* **Organization & Attention to Detail:** Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and provide timely follow-up to ensure a seamless patient experience.
* **Schedule Availability:** Ability to consistently work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Central Time (CST/CDT), regardless of location.

### **About Our Culture:**

* **We are mission-driven:** we're revolutionizing the way cardiovascular care is delivered
* **We are fast-paced & agile:** we move quickly, iterate often, and value experimentation
* **We are remote-first:** ownership, autonomy, and trust are at the core of how we operate
* **We care about diversity**: diversity allows us to build an excellent patient experience
* **We care about each other:** we are stronger together through a culture of mutual respect and active support.

At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

**Our Team**

Product Operations helps teams execute effectively by keeping priorities clear, people aligned, and resources focused on the work that matters most. In this role, you’ll help own Product Operations for Core Discovery, the portfolio responsible for improving the core Netflix experience every day for our members around the world. Our work spans all platforms (TV/living room, mobile, tablet, and web) and includes experiences and ranking/recommendation strategies across discovery/browse (shows, movies, live programming, and games), search, player, and new surfaces.

Product Operations partners closely with the portfolio leader, Product Managers, and cross-functional teams to drive alignment and execution across that work.

  
  

**The Role**

You'll own the operating view of the Core Discovery portfolio — connecting priorities, plans, resources, and progress to help leaders and teams make informed decisions and trade-offs. You'll build the planning processes, operating rhythms, and communication practices that keep teams aligned and work moving without unnecessary bureaucracy.

  
  

You'll also serve as a strategic partner and extension of the portfolio leader, translating ambiguity into action, anticipating issues, and ensuring the right decisions get made at the right time.

  
  

**Specifically, You'l** l:

* Lead portfolio planning and performance: Own the portfolio view of priorities, plans, capacity, and progress; lead planning cycles and Big Rock reviews.
* Build the operating model: Establish effective team rhythms, meetings, onsites, communication flows, and intake mechanisms that support execution without adding unnecessary overhead.
* Connect strategy to impact: Partner with Product and Data Science to track portfolio-level impact hypotheses and outcomes.
* Improve team effectiveness: Identify misalignment, surface dependencies, and use team feedback to continuously improve how work gets done.
* Provide program management support where needed: Step into cross-functional program management to drive complex initiatives forward, connect dependencies, and ensure critical work stays on track.
* Extend the portfolio leader's leverage: Translate strategy and ambiguity into clear plans, frameworks, and decisions; shape leadership discussions, prepare executive communications, and proactively surface emerging issues.
Improve organizational effectiveness: Identify execution gaps, misalignment, and opportunities to improve how teams work; help navigate organizational change and build lasting solutions.  

**What You'll Bring**

* 10+ years of Product Operations, Product or Program Management, Business Operations, or related experience in a product-driven organization.
* A track record of designing and scaling operational processes, rhythms, and systems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, with a high degree of autonomy.
* Fluency with operating cadences such as planning, OKRs, and QBRs, and the ability to turn messy inputs into clear, decision-ready outputs.
* Strong executive communication skills, including developing decks and written narratives for broad audiences.
* Strong cross-functional partnership skills, particularly across Product, Engineering, Program Management, and leadership.
* Sound judgment and the ability to anticipate issues, navigate competing priorities, and identify opportunities to improve how teams operate.
* A bias toward action and willingness to take on ambiguous, unowned problems and build sustainable solutions.
  

  
Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $260,000.00 - $370,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here .

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here .

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, AIR Opportunity Fund
new_jobs.description:
The AIR Opportunity Fund is seeking a **Senior Program Officer** to support and advance the Fund’s grantmaking, research, and partnership activities focused on expanding opportunity and improving outcomes for communities across the United States. As the AIR Opportunity Fund builds depth in workforce and economic opportunity, health, and youth pathways, we are seeking candidates who can strengthen our presence in the Midwest, the Washington, DC, area, or the Deep South. The Senior Program Officer will bring subject-matter knowledge in one or more of these areas, familiarity with the communities and regions we serve, and the initiative to move work forward with direction from senior staff. Working closely with portfolio managers and directors, the Senior Program Officer will lead significant components of the Fund’s grantmaking and programmatic initiatives, provide strategic and analytical guidance, and cultivate relationships with grantees, community leaders, researchers, funders, and other key stakeholders. The ideal candidate will bring substantial experience spanning applied research and philanthropy, demonstrated leadership of complex initiatives and partnerships, and the ability to use evidence and field knowledge to inform strategy, funding decisions, and continuous learning. The Fund's strategic priorities and major grantmaking commitments are largely established, and this role will focus on stewarding existing grants and partnerships, monitoring progress, and supporting implementation and learning activities, rather than sourcing, developing, or approving new grants at this time. The selected candidate will work remotely but must be based in or near one of the Fund's priority regions: the Midwest (Chicago or Cleveland preferred), the greater Washington, DC, area, or the Delta Region (Arkansas, Alabama, or Mississippi preferred). Travel to AIR Opportunity Fund events is expected up to 30%. This position has the flexibility to work remotely within the United States (U.S.) or from one of AIR’s U.S. office locations. This does not include U.S. territories.

#### **About AIR:**

Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the American Institutes for Research (AIR) is a nonpartisan, not-for-profit organization that conducts behavioral and social science research and delivers technical assistance to address some of the most pressing challenges in the United States and globally. We generate evidence and apply data-driven solutions that expand opportunities and improve lives for all.

#### **Responsibilities:**

The responsibilities for the position include:

* Manage assigned components of programmatic initiatives from planning through implementation and evaluation under the direction of portfolio managers and directors.
* Represent the Fund at conferences, community meetings, and field-based events within the assigned region, and nationally, as needed.
* Manage multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously, ensuring timely completion of deliverables.
* Conduct research, landscape analyses, and environmental scans to inform funding decisions, program priorities, and new initiatives.
* Synthesize research findings, field insights, and grantee learnings into reports, briefings, presentations for internal and external audiences.
* Manage relationships with grantees, community organizations, researchers, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate meetings, convenings, site visits, and other stakeholder engagement activities.
* Contribute subject-matter knowledge in workforce and economic opportunity, health, and/or youth pathways.
* Review grant proposals, conduct due diligence, and develop funding recommendations.
* Monitor grant and program performance, track outcomes, and identify opportunities for learning and improvement.
* Collaborate with AIR researchers, subject matter experts, and operational staff.

#### **Qualifications:**

**Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

* Master's degree in public policy, public health, social sciences, education, nonprofit management, community development, or a related field.
* Minimum of seven years of professional experience that includes both applied research and philanthropy, grantmaking, social impact investing, or related funding experience.
* Subject matter expertise in one or more priority areas: workforce and economic opportunity, health, and/or youth pathways.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the communities, organizations, and policy or funding landscape within communities and regions served by the Fund, particularly the Deep South, Cleveland, Chicago, and/or Washington, DC region.
* Demonstrated experience using research, evaluation, or data-driven approaches to inform program design, funding decisions, strategy, or organizational learning.
* Experience managing or supporting grant portfolios, philanthropic initiatives, research projects, or community-based programs.
* Experience working with community-based organizations, research institutions, public agencies, philanthropic organizations, or cross-sector partnerships.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while producing high-quality work.

**Skills**

* Strong research, analytical, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to evaluate evidence and identify actionable insights.
* Effective communication skills, including public speaking and presentation skills and the ability to translate complex information for a variety of audiences.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build productive relationships across a variety of stakeholders.
* Strong relationship-management and influencing skills, with the ability to establish credibility and build productive relationships with community leaders, grantees, researchers, funders, and other stakeholders.
* Advanced project and program management skills, including experience leading complex initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines.

new_jobs.title: Customer Experience Operations Manager, Business Unit
new_jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Our Customer Experience team owns the full post-sales lifecycle for one of Rippling’s largest business units, from onboarding and implementation to escalations and renewals—we’re united by a passion for customers and continuous improvement, and we’re committed to personal and professional growth.

In this role, you're expected to be a builder: you’ll design and run the post-sales operating model for the business unit from the ground up. Our model runs on a lean, task-based system where every motion is defined, measured, and repeatable. You’ll define what success looks like, set the KPIs, map and build the workflows, write the playbooks, and keep refining the machine as the business grows.

You will also bridge data and day-to-day execution: building multi-factor health scores, engineering automated risk interventions, refining lifecycle touch points across the whole Product Experience to maximize retention outcomes.

Last, you’ll be the technical architect of the systems behind it and be the main business partner to CX leadership. You’ll find the truth in the data, turn it into action, and own the outcome.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Build the post-sales operating model for the business unit: define success at each lifecycle stage, set the KPIs, and design how work flows across onboarding, implementation, customer success, escalations, and renewals.
* Own the architecture, data integrity, and configuration of our CX systems. Partner cross-functionally on integrations across CRM, billing, support, and product analytics.
* Analyze intervention outcomes to understand why accounts churn or save, and use what you learn to refine playbooks and train the team on save and de-escalation strategies.
* Establish automated early warning systems that detect leading indicators of churn well before renewal windows open.
* Develop proactive intervention playbooks mapped to specific risk triggers (e.g., missed payments, steep drops in platform activity, repeated support escalations).
* Own the customer sentiment program (NPS, CSAT): build and administer lifecycle-triggered surveys, analyze trends across customer segments, and run a closed-loop detractor playbook.
* Prepare and run weekly business reviews, and deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting on gross and net retention, save rates, health score trends, and operational capacity.
* Manage and mentor a team of Retention Specialists through regular 1:1s, performance coaching, and workflow reviews. Set the SOPs, turnaround targets, and escalation protocols they work from.
* Partner with Product, Sales, and Support to surface upstream product frictions, onboarding bottlenecks, or misaligned customer expectations that contribute to churn.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **A builder.** You want to build the right system or workflow rather than inherit it; you’re comfortable in ambiguity, and you’ve done that before.
* **An owner.** When you see a problem, you act with urgency and you proactively own it until it’s solved; you are effective as a cross-functional operator.
* **A truth seeker.** You go to the data and to the frontline, you challenge assumptions (including your own), and make decisions based on what’s actually happening.
* **Thorough.** You sweat the details in workflows, data, and documentation, because a system is only as good as its details. You keep making the process better.

**What you will have**
----------------------

* 3–10+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, RevOps, or CX Management within a B2B SaaS environment.
* 1+ years of direct people management or lead experience guiding retention, support, or customer success specialists.
* Experience building operations from the ground up in a high-growth environment.
* Track record of designing retention programs, renewal/save programs, and/or building automated risk-alert frameworks tied directly to measurable retention gains.
* Technical comfort owning and building systems; You're comfortable with SFDC, Jira, and/or CSP platforms (e.g. Vitally, Gainsight or ChurnZero), navigating API integrations, bi-directional syncing, and event-based tracking schemas.
* Strong data literacy; proficient in mapping SaaS metrics (NRR, GRR, Churn, LTV, Adoption velocity) and synthesizing raw analytics into operational priorities.
* Emerging AI Tooling Experience: you are comfortable integrating LLMs (e.g., Claude, OpenAI APIs) into CX tech stacks for automated ticket summarization, health score analysis, or retention playbook drafting.

new_jobs.title: Purchasing Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Southern Hobby Distribution, LLC was founded in 1991 with one simple goal: to become our customers’ greatest asset by delivering top-quality products, unmatched customer service, and the most knowledgeable sales staff in the hobby industry.

Southern Hobby Distribution is a Collectivus Holdings company, serving retailers and collectors across the hobby and collectibles industry.

  

**Website:** www.collectivusholdings.com

**Company:** Southern Hobby Distribution | A Collectivus Holdings Company

**Job Title:** Purchasing Operations Manager

**Reporting Line:** EVP, Product

**Job Location:** Remote - US

  

Southern Hobby Distribution is seeking a Purchasing Operations Manager to oversee its buying function, with direct management responsibility for all SHD Buyers and accountability for purchasing execution, inventory performance, and day-to-day vendor relationships.

The Buying Leader partners closely with the EVP, Product on category direction, assortment priorities, significant inventory investments, and strategic vendor matters. The role translates agreed priorities into actionable purchasing plans and holds the buying team accountable for results.

Working with Sales, Finance, Warehouse Operations, and Technology, this leader balances product availability and customer demand with margin, cash flow, and inventory discipline.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Buying Strategy & Category Execution**

* Develop buying and category strategies aligned with business priorities.
* Translate approved category direction into purchasing plans, assortment priorities, and measurable goals for Buyers.
* Review sales trends, market conditions, collector demand, and product performance to recommend buying adjustments.
* Oversee replenishment and purchasing execution within approved budgets and decision guidelines.
* Recommend category expansion, assortment changes, and inventory investments for alignment with the EVP, Product.

### **Buyer Team Leadership**

* Directly manage, coach, and evaluate all SHD Buyers, including hiring, development, and performance management.
* Assign clear category ownership, purchasing responsibilities, approval limits, and escalation expectations.
* Set consistent standards for purchase orders, product setup, vendor communication, forecasting, and inventory management.
* Conduct regular individual and team performance reviews using defined metrics and corrective action plans.
* Build capabilities in data analysis, forecasting, vendor management, and purchasing discipline.

### **Inventory & Financial Performance**

* Develop and manage purchasing plans and open-to-buy budgets with the EVP, Product and Finance.
* Monitor inventory turns, stock availability, weeks of supply, aged and excess inventory, and purchasing commitments.
* Oversee demand forecasting and replenishment to reduce avoidable stockouts and overbuying.
* Identify slow-moving inventory and recommend markdown, liquidation, and end-of-life actions in partnership with Product and Finance.
* Track purchasing budget adherence, category margin trends, and inventory investment risks; recommend timely corrective action.

### **Vendor & Manufacturer Relationships**

* Oversee day-to-day vendor relationships and effective communication by the buying team.
* Partner with the EVP, Product on strategic vendor relationships, major negotiations, and commercial agreements, while managing day-to-day vendor execution and escalating significant commercial matters.
* Ensure Buyers execute agreed pricing, terms, allocations, and vendor commitments accurately.
* Monitor vendor fill rates, lead times, availability, and delivery reliability; address operational issues and escalate material commercial matters.
* Identify potential improvements to allocations, purchasing terms, and vendor performance for review with the EVP, Product.
* Coordinate vendor updates, launches, and industry event participation as needed.

### **Operational Execution & Collaboration**

* Oversee timely, accurate purchase orders and product records, including SKUs, pricing, descriptions, and vendor attributes.
* Coordinate with Sales on demand, customer needs, promotions, and launch planning.
* Work with Warehouse Operations to resolve receiving discrepancies, damages, and product availability issues.
* Partner with Finance on inventory budgets, working capital, and purchasing reporting.
* Work with Technology and Business Intelligence to improve ERP workflows, forecasting, dashboards, and data quality.
* Establish consistent purchasing controls, decision rights, and escalation processes.

### **Business Performance & Accountability**

Strivant Health is seeking an experienced Manager, Quality Assurance – Revenue Cycle Operations to lead and strengthen our quality assurance program across multiple healthcare revenue cycle clients.
  
  
This role goes beyond managing audits and reporting results. The Manager will build a structured, proactive quality program that identifies performance risks, uncovers trends, drives measurable improvement, and helps ensure we consistently meet client expectations.

This individual will partner closely with Operations and Training to strengthen accountability, improve performance, and identify quality concerns before they become client escalations.

Identify opportunities to automate and streamline QA processes, reducing manual tracking and improving the efficiency, consistency, and accuracy of reporting.
  
  
Drive accountability and follow-through, ensuring recurring quality issues have documented action plans and that corrective actions result in measurable improvement.
  
  
Promote consistency and continuous improvement across clients, teams, and revenue cycle functions.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
  
5+ years of healthcare RCM experience with a background in quality assurance, auditing, or performance improvement.

Strong knowledge of RCM workflows, quality metrics, scorecards, and root cause analysis.
  
  
Strong Excel and reporting skills; Power BI experience preferred.
  
  
Proven ability to turn quality data into actionable performance improvements.
  
  
Strong leadership, communication, and client-facing skills.
  
  
Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  
  
Experience with healthcare billing systems and Microsoft Office applications.

Success in this role means creating greater visibility, consistency, and accountability across our quality program. Why This Role Matters
  
  
Quality is more than an audit score. It directly affects our clients, our teams, and revenue cycle performance. new_jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Manager - USA
new_jobs.description:
#### **Help make the world more hospitable**

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building.

If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here.

#### **About the role**

Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You will own the customer relationship from handover to go-live, guiding hotels through setup, training and rollout so the platform works for them from day one. Each go-live is the first real test of whether Mews fits the way a property runs, and the quality of that experience shapes whether a customer stays and grows with us. Mews serves hotels across EMEA, and the portfolio is large enough that how well you onboard is felt in the numbers.

As a Customer Onboarding Manager, you run several mid-market and enterprise implementations at the same time, often phased across multiple properties or regions. You work with customer stakeholders on one side and with Sales, Support and RevOps on the other, so that what was agreed in the sale is what gets delivered at go-live.

The problem this role solves sits in the period between signing and a working go-live. Configuration choices, integration issues and timeline slips that surface late are costly for the customer and for us. You spot them early, make risk-informed trade-offs, and give customers credible advice on setup so they adopt the product and are ready to run on it.

**What you would do**

* Run several onboarding projects at once, at different stages and levels of complexity, within SLA targets, including phased rollouts across multiple properties and regions
* Configure the product for each customer, diagnose integration issues, and advise on setup decisions, flagging configuration, data and timeline risks early
* Train customer stakeholders with different needs, drive adoption through to go-live, and keep Sales, Support and RevOps aligned along the way
* Use AI to draft documentation, prepare for customer sessions and keep project tracking efficient
* Check AI-generated material for accuracy before it reaches a customer or colleague, and share what works with the team

**AI Fluency Level 2:** In this role, AI is part of your regular working week, for example drafting customer documentation, preparing for training sessions and keeping project tracking tidy, and it makes you noticeably faster and better at onboarding work. Just as important, you check what it gives you: you read it critically, correct it, and only share it with a customer or colleague once you are sure it is accurate.

*For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to* *AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates* *on Confluence.*

**What you would bring**

* 3 to 5 years in SaaS onboarding, implementation or customer-facing technical roles
* Experience managing concurrent mid-market or enterprise implementations, including phased rollouts across multiple properties or regions
* Deep SaaS product knowledge: you can configure complex products, diagnose integration issues and advise customers credibly on setup decisions
* Strong communication and training skills for diverse customer stakeholders, stakeholder management across customers, Sales, Support and RevOps, and structured project management across several projects at once
* AI Fluency Level 2 in your day-to-day work, with strong discernment: you critically evaluate AI output before sharing it with customers or colleagues

**Nice to have**

* Experience in hospitality technology or an adjacent sector (hotel management, PMS, POS, payments), or familiarity with Mews Hospitality Cloud or a comparable multi-module SaaS platform
* Multilingual, relevant for EMEA portfolio coverage
* Experience contributing to onboarding playbooks, SOPs or team knowledge bases, or using AI tools to draft training materials, automate repetitive documentation or manage project tracking

#### **Pay Transparency at Mews**

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

#### **What's in it for you?**

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

#### **Global benefits**

No matter where you're based, you'll enjoy:

* Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
* Participation in our company share program
* Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
* An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
* Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
* A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks

**About YouScience, LLC**

YouScience® is the leading education technology company dedicated to empowering individuals with the data and credentials needed to succeed in school, career, and life.

Its award-winning platform, YouScience Brightpath®, is the only College & Career Readiness solution built for both compliance and impact—powered by scientifically backed aptitude discovery, industry-recognized certifications, and meaningful career connections.

YouScience has served more than 13,400 educational institutions and millions of users nationwide, making it the preferred choice for individuals, parents, educators, and counselors to achieve real outcomes through education and career pathways.

**Job Description**

The Manager of Sales Enablement will be responsible for equipping our revenue teams with the knowledge, content, and tools required to drive growth and improve sales productivity in the education technology sector. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to build, deliver, and continuously optimize onboarding programs, ongoing training, and sales enablement resources. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, combining a strong understanding of B2B/EdTech sales cycles with expertise in instructional design and revenue technology platforms. By bridging product knowledge, market insights, and sales execution, you will play a critical role in helping sales representatives achieve consistent quota performance and accelerate time-to-value for customers. Successful candidates will bring a proactive, data-driven approach to identifying skill gaps, measuring training impact, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and high performance.

This role has the flexibility to be remote, in office (American Fork, Utah), or hybrid.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and manage comprehensive onboarding programs for new sales representatives to accelerate time to productivity.
* Develop and maintain a centralized repository of sales collateral, playbooks, battle cards, and pitch decks in collaboration with Product Marketing.
* Partner with sales leadership to identify skill and knowledge gaps across account executives and territory managers, creating targeted training initiatives.
* Administer and optimize sales technology tools, learning management systems (LMS), and revenue enablement platforms to support day-to-day sales operations.
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate the effectiveness of enablement programs and report metrics to executive stakeholders.
* Facilitate ongoing continuous education, including product releases, competitive positioning, consultative selling methodologies, and industry trends.
* Conduct regular ride-alongs and call reviews (e.g., via Gong) to coach representatives on discovery, handling objections, and closing strategies.
* Collaborate with Product and Marketing teams to translate complex software features into compelling, value-based customer messaging.
* Organize and execute sales enablement events, quarterly sales training workshops, and annual sales kick-off (SKO) programming.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Education, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3-5+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales Training, Product Marketing, or B2B SaaS Sales Excellence roles.
* Proven track record of designing, building, and delivering successful onboarding and continuous training programs for sales teams.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales enablement/LMS technologies (e.g., Docebo, LearnUpon, Gong, Highspot).
* Exceptional presentation, facilitation, and communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences and senior executives.
* Strong understanding of consultative selling methodologies and B2B SaaS buyer journeys.

### **Extra Credit**

* Direct experience working within the Education Technology (EdTech) or K-12 / Higher Education market sectors.
* Prior individual contributor experience in quota-carrying B2B software sales or account management.
* Familiarity with career and technical education (CTE), aptitude assessments, or industry-recognized certifications.
* Formal certifications in sales methodologies (e.g., Challenger, MEDDPICC, Solution Selling) or Instructional Design.

**The Opportunity**  
The Product Business Operations role is part of the Products team and is responsible for the day-to-day commercial operations of NTS's software business. This person owns the processes that carry a customer from final deal coordination through license fulfillment, ongoing engagement, and renewal.  
Working with sales representatives, Customer Success, Product, Contracts, and Finance, the role keeps customer records accurate, transactions moving, forecasts current, and follow-up actions complete. Sales representatives retain responsibility for outside sales, new-business prospecting, account strategy, and commercial negotiations.

  

**Key Responsibilities** (Principal Duties and Accountabilities \*Essential Functions)

  

Deal Completion and Post Award Coordination

* Support representatives in completing quotes, approvals, order forms, purchase orders, and customer documentation needed to close and process software deals.
* Validate products, quantities, pricing, license terms, support coverage, and delivery requirements against approved orders; resolve discrepancies with Sales, Contracts, and Finance.
* Own the post-award handoff and action tracker through fulfillment, customer receipt, and billing readiness; escalate delays and missing information.

License Fulfillment and Entitlement Management

* Coordinate license issuance, delivery, activation instructions, and receipt confirmation; route technical activation or deployment issues to the appropriate team.
* Maintain accurate records of licensed products, quantities, customer entities, license terms, expiration dates, and maintenance or support entitlements.
* Process approved renewals, expansions, transfers, and license changes; track trial and evaluation expirations with the account representative.

CRM and Forecast Management

* Own CRM data quality across accounts, subaccounts, contacts, opportunities, orders, and renewals; reconcile records with license and transaction information.
* Run a regular forecast review with representatives to validate opportunity values, stages, close dates, procurement status, next steps, and accountable owners.
* Scrub stale opportunities, duplicate records, missing fields, and unsupported close dates; obtain representative updates and flag changes or risks for leadership.

Customer Outreach and Sales Coordination

* Conduct welcome, fulfillment, administrative, and follow-up outreach; maintain current end-user, purchasing, and reseller contacts and track requests to completion.
* Work with representatives to prioritize accounts needing outreach, quote follow-up, procurement assistance, or re-engagement; agree on owners and next actions.
* Coordinate onboarding and customer communications with Customer Success; surface adoption concerns, customer feedback, and expansion opportunities to the appropriate owner.

Renewals and Retention

* Own the renewal calendar and begin outreach early enough to accommodate customer budgeting and procurement timelines; keep representatives informed of upcoming expirations.
* Drive renewal quotes, reminders, approvals, purchase documentation, and fulfillment through completion; coordinate pricing or scope changes with the account representative.
* Identify potential lapses, reductions, or nonrenewals; coordinate recovery actions and record renewal outcomes and reasons for lost or reduced business.

Software Business Operations and Reporting

* Provide fulfillment records for invoicing and work with Finance and representatives to resolve order, billing, and payment-status issues.
* Maintain actionable reports on bookings, recurring revenue, renewals, fulfillment, forecast changes, and outstanding customer actions using definitions and records agreed with Finance.
* Maintain approved product and SKU information, templates, and operating procedures; improve handoffs and routine workflows to reduce errors and manual effort.

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**  
Individual contributor with no direct reports. Manages business processes and coordinates work across teams; operates within established pricing, contracting, and financial approval policies.

* Strong written and spoken English; professional customer communication; ability to handle sensitive customer and commercial information with discretion.
* Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance up to the Secret level.

  

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

  

**Required Skills, Experience & Abilities**

* Minimum 4 years of experience in software business operations, sales operations, revenue operations, renewals, customer operations, or a related role.
* Hands-on CRM experience, including account and opportunity maintenance, data cleanup, reporting, and forecast coordination.
* Experience with software orders, licensing, subscriptions or maintenance renewals, and customer fulfillment processes.
* Strong spreadsheet skills and ability to reconcile customer, order, license, and forecast data accurately.
* Ability to manage competing deadlines, follow up persistently, resolve operational issues, and drive actions to completion across teams.
* Sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to communicate clearly with customers, representatives, and business leaders.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting government or defense customers, contract awards, purchase orders, resellers, and extended procurement cycles.
* Familiarity with both subscription and perpetual software licensing, support renewals, retention reporting, and recurring revenue metrics.
* Experience improving CRM workflows, documenting operating procedures, or automating routine business tasks.
